title: Jelly Yeet!
description: Launch a bouncy jelly from the backyard into space! Time your swing for a perfect hit, bounce off trampolines, bump into airborne objects, and travel through portals. Use your mid-air slam to keep the action going, earn coins, and upgrade your power, bounce, and slam. Unlock funny jelly skins and unique clubs, then chase your next distance record!
instructions:
Click, tap, or press Space to stop the timing meter and launch your jelly. Aim for the perfect zone for a stronger shot!

During flight, click, tap, or press Space again to use your slam once per launch. Hit springy objects for powerful bounces.

Earn coins to buy upgrades and unlock jelly skins and clubs. On mobile, turn your device sideways to play in landscape mode.

title: Block Runner: Subway Escape
description: Subway Mini World Craft Game is a fun block adventure where you can explore, mine, craft and build! Discover a colorful mini world, collect resources, mine blocks and create amazing structures. Explore the subway world, build your own houses and enjoy creative adventures. Start mining, crafting and building today in this exciting mini world game!
instructions:
HOW TO PLAY

? MOBILE
• Use the joystick to move.
• Swipe to look around.
• Tap to mine and interact.
• Select blocks from your inventory to build.

? PC
• Use WASD or Arrow Keys to move.
• Use the Mouse to look around.
• Left Click to mine or interact.
• Right Click to place blocks.
• Number Keys to select blocks.
• Press R to Restart.

title: Build a Go-Kart
description:
Build your karting empire from scratch — from simple straights to complex tracks with boosts and risky turns.

Design unique tracks using modular blocks: combine elements, optimize your route, and find the perfect balance between speed and profit. Every ride earns money — and your track design determines how much you make.
instructions:
Build your track by placing different blocks. Drive your kart along it, earn money for each segment, and use that income to unlock new blocks, expand your area, and improve your track for even higher profits.

Controls:
PC: WASD — move, Space — jump/exit kart, E — interact, mouse — camera.
Mobile: virtual joystick — move, jump and interact buttons, touch controls — camera.

title: Rainbow Friends. Survival
description:
A fun and dangerous game about Rainbow Friends!
You are in a dangerous place. You need to survive 5 days and 5 nights, but the deadly obstacle will be the terrifying and bloodthirsty monsters Rainbow Friends!
Complete all the missions, move fast, perform actions carefully and run away from the monstrous monsters!
instructions:
The goal of the game is to complete all the missions and survive.
PC control: Arrows - movement, E - interaction.
Control on a mobile device: touch on game elements on the touch screen.

title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
description:
Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye!

Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!
instructions: Tap on the screen and pull to charge your epic bow area, watch the bow and arrow for direction, and release. Score game points by picking the best angle of attack. The physics in this casual game are very realistic and fun to explore.

title: Cupid’s Story: Love Archer Bow
description: In Cupid's Story: Love Archer Bow, you play as a love archer armed with a trusty bow. Your mission is to shoot love arrows that connect hearts and spark romance. Aim carefully and watch as sparks fly and love blooms in the most unexpected places. Mix and match hearts to create unique and charming couples, from quirky characters to unlikely pairings. The possibilities are endless in this one-of-a-kind game.
instructions: Shoot your arrows at targets to match them together!

title: Bowmasters
description: Bowmasters is a fun and action-packed game that combines creative physics with exciting Archery gameplay. Use different types of bows and weapons. Draw your weapon, judge the angle, and fire arrows to hit all enemies. The game shines with its physics-based mechanics, where timing, distance, and trajectory matter. You’ll need real skill and smart thinking to solve each shooting puzzle and land accurate hits. Every match feels different thanks to unique characters and varied weapons.
instructions: Click and drag to play.

title: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek
description: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek is an exciting and fast-paced hide-and-seek adventure game set in a colorful yet dangerous rainbow world. Step into this thrilling role-playing experience, choose your role, and get ready for an unforgettable adventure.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Obby Rainbow Tower
description: Obby Rainbow Tower is a fast, winter-themed tower race where every second and every jump matters. Each floor is packed with moving platforms, icy tiles, spinning lava bars, surprise snowstorms and snowball portals that try to knock you into the void.  You can replay the tower as many times as you like, trying to beat your own best time or racing a friend side by side in 2 player mode.
instructions:
Player 1: Move W A S D, Sprint Shift, Jump Space, Double Jump Space+Space
Player 2: Move Arrows, Sprint K, Jump L, Double Jump L+L
Mobile: On-screen buttons.

title: Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake
description: Whip up layers of color and sweetness in Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake! Mix, bake, and frost your way to the perfect rainbow treat, then finish with cute decorations that make your cake sparkle with charm.
instructions: Use MOUSE to play games.

title: Ninja Platformer Rage
description:
Master your ninja skills in a challenging platformer where every jump matters!

Run, jump and overcome 50 handcrafted levels filled with traps, obstacles and unexpected challenges. Use your shadow to reach places you normally can't, then teleport back to it at the perfect moment.

Some levels will test your reflexes, others your precision — and some might completely mess with your sense of scale a
instructions:
PC
- A / D or Arrow Keys — Move
- Space — Jump
- Shift — Throw Shadow
- Double Shift — Teleport to Shadow


Mobile
- Left / Right — Move
- Jump — Jump
- Shadow — Throw Shadow
- Dash — Teleport to Shadow

title: Moto Extreme: Halloween Land
description: In this Halloween-themed 3D side-scrolling motorcycle game, an exciting riding experience awaits you on dark and mysterious tracks. Overcome challenging obstacles, keep your motorcycle balanced, and complete a variety of dangerous tracks. Carefully navigate through a world designed with a spooky atmosphere, use your riding skills, and try to reach the end of each track. Control your motorcycle, ov
instructions:
Use the "W" and "Arrow Up" keys to move forward.
Use the "S" and "Arrow Down" keys to move backward.
Use the "A" and "D" keys or the "Arrow Left" and "Arrow Right" keys to balance the motorcycle.

title: Fruit Box Sort
description: Sort colorful fruit boxes in a relaxing puzzle game. Tap open boxes to send fruit onto the conveyor belt and fill matching containers. Plan your moves, keep space on the belt, and discover 210 levels with mystery boxes, fruit barrels, ice and linked boxes. Use helpful boosters when you need a hand. Progress is saved in your browser.
instructions: Desktop: left-click boxes and buttons. Mobile: tap boxes and buttons. Choose an accessible fruit box, match fruit with the containers below, and avoid filling the conveyor belt.

title: Zipzap
description: ZipZap is a fun and challenging number-path puzzle game where players connect numbers in the correct order to complete each puzzle. Choose from Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty modes, solve 63 levels in each mode, improve your best time and score, and challenge yourself with daily puzzles.
instructions: Start by selecting number 1, then use the mouse, touch controls, or keyboard arrow keys to move through the grid and connect the numbers in the correct order. Complete the path without making mistakes. Use hints when needed and try to finish each puzzle as quickly as possible.

title: Tiny Kingdoms
description: Build a tiny kingdom across three ages. Gather resources, upgrade buildings, recruit an army and conquer 30 territories through the Tribal, Medieval and Industrial eras. Choose tactical perks, use battle skills and carry permanent legacies into the next age. Every soldier matters: casualties are permanent, so plan your upgrades and formations carefully.
instructions: Click or tap buildings to upgrade them. Open Conquer to choose a territory, recruit troops, adjust your formation and deploy. During battle, use Rally and aim Barrage at enemies. Switch between 1x and 2x battle speed. Press Escape to close a panel or pause battle. Best played in landscape orientation.

title: Strike Bullet
description: Strike Bullet is a ricochet puzzle shooter. Aim carefully, bounce your shot off metal walls, and take out every enemy. Plan your angle, watch the trajectory, and clear 20 levels packed with challenge!
instructions:
Desktop Controls:

Mouse: Aim by moving the cursor.
Left Click: Fire your bullet.
R: Restart the current level.

Mobile Controls:

Touch & Drag: Aim by dragging on the screen.
Release / Tap: Fire your bullet.
Restart Button: Restart the current level from the in-game UI.

title: Snake and Ladders
description: Climb ladders, dodge snakes, and race to the finish! Roll the dice and enjoy a colorful twist on the classic board game, where every turn can change your luck.
instructions: Click or tap the dice to roll and move your piece. Climb ladders to advance and watch out for snakes that slide you back! Roll a 6 to get an extra turn. Be the first player to reach square 100 to win.

title: SNACK & WARP
description: Eat apples, grow and solve 67 colorful puzzles! Lift crates, send them through portals and use buttons to change your route. Blade apples split your worm into two equal halves: switch between them to hold doors, support crates or stop saws. Plan your bites and leave room for your tail. Collect every apple, meet the goals and guide either worm to the purple exit. Enjoy free undo, three-star challen
instructions: Arrow keys / WASD: move. On mobile, swipe or tap the arrows. Q or 1 / 2: select a worm; you can also tap it. Z: undo. R: restart. H: video hint. Esc: menu. Collect all apples, meet button/crate goals and guide either worm into the purple exit. Only crates travel through the paired portals.

title: Sky Golfer
description: Sky Golfer is a physics-based puzzle game where your objective is to guide a golf ball from a starting point to the hole. The golf ball rests on a complex structure made entirely of flat, interconnected platforms. Your primary mechanism for moving the ball is to rotate the entire platform structure either clockwise or anti-clockwise by set increments.
instructions:
On Desktop/PC:
 -Rotate Left (Anti-Clockwise): Hold the Left Arrow key 
-Right (Clockwise): Hold the Right Arrow key

 On Mobile:
 -Simply tap and hold the on-screen buttons on the left or right side of the display to rotate the platforms in that direction.

title: Pixel Path 2
description: You'll play as Pixel Tadpole. You'll have to navigate twenty challenging levels. The difficulty increases with each level. You'll need to be attentive and agile to complete them all. Spikes, pits, and falling coconuts are just a few of the challenging challenges that await you. Your nervous system will need to be strong to successfully complete the levels. Only the most experienced players will be
instructions:

A, D, Left Arrow, Right Arrow - character controls
Space - Jump

Mobile device controls:
Tap the on-screen touch game buttons

You need to reach the flag to complete the level.

title: Bubble Merge: Word Sort
description:
Discover a relaxing word puzzle where every move counts. Your goal is to sort word bubbles into their correct categories and clear the board using logic, observation, and vocabulary.

Features:

Simple controls with satisfying gameplay
Helpful boosters for challenging levels
Relaxing experience that exercises your brain
Play anytime, even without an internet connection
instructions: Use mouse drag and merge bubble to same category and clear them!

title: Cursed gift
description:
Death is not the end—it is only the beginning of your rise. You have been brought back to life by the very embodiment of Death to become the last hope of a dying kingdom. The lands are ravaged by insane cultists and the possessed, and only a true Lord of the Dead can restore order here.
Lead the Legions of Darkness: raise fallen enemies, making them part of your undead army, and combine squads of
instructions:
WASD — move your character.
Q, E, R, F — activate abilities.
Hold C to open the potion wheel and select one.
LMB — interact, select a unit squad.
Hold LMB and move the mouse to drag a selection area and choose multiple squads.
RMB — issue an order to selected units.
Esc — pause.

title: Freekick Clash
description: Freekick Clash: The ultimate football freekick game! Aim and shoot, beat the goalkeeper, and score spectacular goals. Select your favorite team, challenge the wall, and win the world cup! Enjoy realistic ball physics and addictive arcade action.
instructions: Use Mouse to aim and shoot.

title: Circles
description: Test your reflexes in this addictive pattern-matching quest. Trace the sequence of the circles with lightning speed to keep the game alive. Don't forget to tap your Bonus Boosters at the bottom to trigger epic chain reactions and crush the global leaderboard!
instructions: Test your reflexes in this addictive pattern-matching quest. Trace the sequence of the circles with lightning speed to keep the game alive. Don't forget to tap your Bonus Boosters at the bottom to trigger epic chain reactions and crush the global leaderboard!

title: Flying Robot Transform Car Game
description: Transform into a powerful Wolf Robot and battle enemy machines in an open-world futuristic city. Switch between a robot, car, and wolf to complete action-packed missions, defeat enemies, and save the city from destruction. Choose between exciting Mission Mode and Free Mode.

Desktop
WASD = Move
Mouse: UI and Actions
ESC = Pause
TAB = Settings
N = Skip Level

Mobile
On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick.

title: Ball and Maze
description: Roll your way to victory in Ball and Maze, a captivating physics-based puzzle adventure! Guide a rolling ball through intricate mazes by tilting or sliding it, collecting shiny stars along the path while avoiding dead ends and obstacles. The core idea is precise control and clever pathfinding—navigate tight corners, gather every star for maximum points, and reach the exit to conquer each level.
instructions:
PC Controls:
Mouse: Click and drag/slide on the screen to tilt or move the ball in the desired direction.
(Alternatively, use arrow keys if supported for precise tilting.)
Mobile Controls:
Touchscreen: Swipe or drag your finger on the screen to tilt the maze and roll the ball.
(Drag left/right/up/down to control direction and momentum.)

title: Drag Shift: Street Race
description: Master the launch, nail every shift and burn NOS in Drag Shift: Street Race, a precision neon drag-racing game. Climb 3 districts and 60 events, beat 18 rival crew drivers, tune 25 cars with 5 upgrade paths, and chase your own ghost for the perfect run. Easy to learn, hard to master — how low can your ET go?
instructions:
LAUNCH: Hold GAS (or Up/W) and keep the needle in the green zone before the lights turn green.
SHIFT: Tap SHIFT UP (or Space) when it glows green — perfect shifts are faster and boost torque.
NOS: Tap NOS (or N) from 2nd gear up. Higher gears benefit more.
Touch buttons on mobile, keyboard on desktop. Beat the rival, earn cash, upgrade your car!

title: ENDLESS
description:
Run up the endless stairs!
Tap or hold the Climb button to climb.
Press the Turn button to change direction.
Don’t slow down, or the monster will catch you!
Turn the wrong way, and it’s game over.
Magic Flask: Climb with only the Climb button for a limited time.
Blue Lantern: Makes the monster disappear for a limited time.
instructions:
Tap repeatedly or hold the Climb button to climb the stairs.
Press the Turn button to change direction.

title: Candy Sort
description: Candy Sort is a colorful sorting puzzle where you move candies between tubes and group them by color. Place candies only in empty tubes or on the same-colored candy. Race against the clock, and when you need help, watch a short reward ad to add an extra tube or stop the timer for unlimited time.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to move candies between tubes. Place a candy in an empty tube or on top of a candy of the same color.

title: Tilt Merge
description:
Tilt Merge is a number puzzle with one extra move that changes everything.

Drop numbered blocks into five columns. Equal neighbours merge and double, and a block landing on two or three twins takes them all for extra points. Merges chain.

The twist is the tilt: swipe left or right and every row slides to that wall. Charges are scarce and refill as you merge, so each one is a decision.

No timer.
instructions: Tap or click a column to drop the block shown next to the board. Swipe left or right, or press the TILT buttons, to slide every row to that wall. The SMASH button removes any single block: press it, then tap the block. Keyboard: arrow keys or 1-5 choose a column, Space drops, Q and E tilt, P opens the menu.

title: Movie Night Glam Dress Up
description: Movie Night Glam Dress Up is a stylish fashion game where you can create the perfect look for a fun and glamorous movie night. Get ready for an evening of entertainment by choosing fashionable outfits, beautiful hairstyles, makeup, and eye-catching accessories.
instructions: Left Mouse button click or Tap to play

title: Frogie - Cross the road
description:
Guide your frog through fast-paced lanes, dodge dangerous obstacles, and survive as long as possible in this fun and addictive arcade challenge!

Swipe or use keyboard controls to move left, right, or jump forward while carefully timing every move. The further you go, the more intense the challenge becomes. Collect points, improve your reflexes, and beat your highest score in this colorful HTML5 w

• On desktop, use the Arrow Keys to control movement
• Tap and hold to reveal directional jump arrows
• Drag toward a direction and release to jump
• Plan your jumps carefully to avoid obstacles
• Keep moving forward to increase your score
• The game becomes faster and more challenging over time

Quick reflexes and smart timing are the key to survival!

title: Jellyphants

Baby elephants are hungry! 

Feed them with delicious jelly and enjoy the flow!

Use conveyor belt to feed a lot of elephants at once, but be warned - they are picky and only eat jelly of their own color.
instructions: Tap to the elephant to send it to the conveyor. If elephant returned to the waiting spot. tap on it to send it to the conveyor again.

Enjoy romantic vibes, laughter, and creative fashion fun in this interactive couple game. Perfect for fans of makeover games, fashion design, and love s

instructions: Control your runner with a single tap. Timing is everything. Avoid obstacles, grab coins and survive as long as you can. Use power-ups like double jump, jetpack and invincibility to stay in the game. One wrong move and it’s over.

title: Planet Blast: Rockets

Take control of a rocket arsenal and turn entire worlds into blazing craters. Choose a target, adjust the design, and watch a precise strike reshape the planet.

Every launch is a search for the perfect balance of fuel, mass, and blast power. Upgrade modules, unlock new planets, and reach the farthest corners of the galaxy.

instructions: use mouse only

title: Pyramid Solitaire
description:
Clear the pyramid by pairing cards that sum to 13 (Jacks=11, Queens=12, Kings=13).

Setup: Deal 28 cards into a 7-row pyramid. Place the rest in a Draw pile.

Play: Match any two exposed cards totaling 13. Kings are removed solo. You can draw from the Stock to find matches; unmatched draws are discarded.

Goal: Reach a score of zero by clearing all pyramid cards. The game ends when no more pairs c
instructions: Clear the pyramid by pairing cards that sum to 13 (Jacks=11, Queens=12, Kings=13).

description: Stumble Boys Party Royale is an exciting multiplayer party royale game where you compete across a collection of chaotic mini-games! Each round randomly selects a different Mini-game, so you never know whether you will be sprinting toward a checkpoint, searching for the right door, or trying to stay on the last remaining platform

description: Link up numbers that match, fuse them into one, and double your way up the grid. There's always a bigger tile a swipe away, the neon glow keeps you coming back, and a little pig celebrates every combo like it hit the jackpot.
instructions: Drag to link matching numbers, double them, and chase 2048 with a cheeky neon pig!

title: Car Eats Car 3D
description: Car Eats Car 3D is a fast-paced action racing game with explosive car battles. Fight alien invaders, complete missions, and defeat powerful bosses. Unlock unique cars, upgrade their stats, and equip powerful weapons. Smash, bite, shoot, and destroy enemies in intense demolition battles. Play online or offline and become the ultimate car battle champion.
instructions:
Arrow Up / W - Gas
Arrow Down / S - Brake
Arrow Left / A - Move left 
Arrow Right / D - Move right
Space - Bombs 
Left Shift / M - Turbo

title: Bubble Shooter Fruits
description: Bubble Shooter Fruits is a bright and colorful bubble-shooting puzzle with juicy fruit bubbles and progressively challenging levels. Aim carefully, match fruits of the same type, and clear the board to complete each stage. Plan your shots, use clever rebounds, and see how far you can progress!
instructions: Aim and shoot fruit bubbles toward the bubbles at the top of the screen. Match 3 or more fruits of the same type to pop them. Use the walls to bounce shots and reach difficult spots. Clear the required bubbles to complete the level and advance to the next stage. Try to finish each level with the highest score possible!

Mix and match outfits inspired by the vibrant streets of New York, the golden sunsets of Tuscany, the mesmerizing festivals, the traditional beauty of Japan, and the enchanting charm of Scotland. With endless options for dressing up and a touch of wit and fun,
instructions: Use your mouse to play this game on a desktop, tap to play on mobile devices.

title: Arrow Sand Puzzle
description:
Arrow Sand Puzzle combines arrow puzzles with colorful sand sorting. Tap an arrow with a clear path to send it out of the board and watch it turn into flowing sand. Fill the matching buckets below while keeping the conveyor belt from overflowing.

Think ahead, choose your moves carefully, and work through 100 levels. Use Hammer, Shuffle, and Clear boosters when you need a little help. Simple tap c

Desktop: Left-click an arrow to move it in the direction it points. Click a booster to use it.
Mobile: Tap an arrow or a booster. An arrow can leave only when its path is clear.

instructions:
-Place Hex tiles on the grid

title: Galaxy Tank Battle
description: Write your name in the stars with your laser mastery. Perfect physics-based shots, customize your tank and defeat every rival. Anticipate their moves, strike first and let your laser be the last thing they see. The galaxy is watching.
instructions: Tap, hold and release to fire your laser. Adjust your angle and power to hit enemies across long distances. Upgrade your stats — Health helps you survive longer, Armor gives extra protection and Damage boosts your firepower. Challenge stronger opponents as you improve your aim.

title: Demolition Tycoon 3D
description: Start with a mini loader and build a demolition fleet, one building at a time. Hold to strike, break away sections and earn coins as your power grows with every hit. Upgrade power, speed, profit and critical hits, then save for bigger machines. Complete 80 contracts across seven districts, from a backyard to the harbor and alpine heights. Unlock seven machines, including the Titan crusher, and con
instructions: Mouse or touch: hold the demolition button or the building. Keyboard: hold Space to strike; Escape opens or closes settings. Clear each building, collect the reward and start the next contract. Buy upgrades and open Fleet to unlock and equip machines. Optional rewarded videos offer bonuses.

title: Cave Maze
description: Cave Maze is an atmospheric maze-exploration game. Guide your torchlight through a dark cave, collecting keys and embers before your fuel runs out. Avoid the wandering spirit that hunts you through the shadows, cross crumbling bridges carefully, and race the clock to reach the exit. Unlock new flame colors with coins earned in-game or from a quick rewarded ad.
instructions: Use arrow keys or swipe/tap to move through the maze — no complex controls needed.

title: Capybas
description: Capybas is a cozy logic puzzle game that blends the deduction of Minesweeper with the rule-based thinking of Sudoku. Find the hidden capybaras by using clues from colors, rows, columns, and adjacency rules. Complete levels, earn coins, and unlock new capybaras and themes as you progress through Easy, Medium, and Hard modes.
instructions: Choose a difficulty and start a board. Each color region hides exactly one capybara, and each row and column can also contain only one capybara. Capybaras cannot touch each other, even diagonally. Tap once to mark with an X the places where you think there are no capybaras, and double tap a square when you think a capybara is hidden there. Find them all before you run out of lives.

title: Brass Labyrinth
description: Brass Labyrinth is a slide-to-wall puzzle set on a warm walnut-and-brass desk toy. Flick the marble to glide until it hits a wall—reading the whole route ahead instead of crawling tile-by-tile. Navigate one-way brass gates, dodge pits, and collect all gems to unlock the exit hatch. Master 300 boards with 3-star ratings, using Undo, Hints, and custom marble skins.
instructions:
Move: Swipe or use WASD/Arrows. The marble slides continuously until blocked by a wall.

Gates & Hazards: One-way brass gates open only in the arrow's direction. Avoid pits or restart the board.

Goal: Collect all gems on the board to unlock the hatch, then roll in to complete the level.

Rewards: Finish in fewer moves for 3 stars. Use Undo or Hint (rewarded ads available) if stuck.

title: Lumen Ruin Runner
description:
Lumen Ruin Runner is a fast-paced arcade adventure where you run,
jump, dodge hazards, collect energy, and unlock your way through
challenging levels.
instructions:
Use the keyboard to move and jump. Avoid hazards, collect energy,
and reach the end of each level.

instructions: Pull the ball back and release. The further you pull, the harder the shot. Choose a projectile with the buttons at the top right; use the map button at the bottom left.

title: Klumen
description:
Filaments of light lie scattered and twisted apart. Tap a tile to turn it, and join every filament to its neighbour until light flows from the heart-star through the whole weave — and it wakes.

Hundreds of always-solvable puzzles that grow with you: obstacles, portals, one-way valves, linked gears, and prisms that mix two colours into a third. The music is made by the game as you play — slow note
instructions: Tap or click a tile to rotate it. Join every filament to its neighbour until the light flows from the star in the centre through the whole board. One thumb, no account, nothing to install.

title: Magic Slide
description:
Slide blocks to complete horizontal lines!
New blocks rise from the bottom each time you move a block.
Don’t let the blocks reach the top!
Clear blocks to fill the pot gauge and reveal diamonds.
Aim for a high score!
instructions: Drag to move blocks sideways.

title: Unite Words
description: Find groups of 4 related words and place them in the same row to complete a set. Swap words between rows to arrange them correctly. Some levels contain special sets that, when completed, reveal new words for you to group. Complete all the sets before the time runs out! If you get stuck, use a hint to highlight a group of words.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to select and swap words between rows, then group 4 related words in the same row to complete a set.

title: Blockland Oneblock Skyblock
description: Are you ready for an adventure that starts with a small island and a single block in the sky? In OneBlock Skyblock, use your resources wisely to expand your island, discover new resources, and build your own world. As you break the single block, different resources and surprises will appear. Expand your island, build structures, manage your resources, and become stronger as you progress. Start wit
instructions: Move using the "WASD" keys. Use "Shift" to prevent yourself from falling. Press "Space" to jump. Use the mouse to break or place blocks. Mobile touch controls are also available.

title: BirdDuko
description: Every colour patch hides one bird. Work out where they're sitting! Birddoku is a calm logic puzzle: place one bird in each colour, never two in the same row or column, and never two touching, not even corner to corner. Boards start at a gentle 4x4 and grow to 9x9, with new levels that keep coming.
instructions:
Tap a square once to cross it out. Tap a crossed square again to place a bird. Tap a bird to remove it. Drag across squares to cross out several at once.
Rules: one bird per colour patch, one per row and column, and birds may not touch, even diagonally.
A wrong bird costs a heart; lose all 3 and the level restarts. Use Hint to reveal a bird and Undo to step back.

title: Bike Obby Draw Pencil
description: Use your creativity and reflexes to complete the missing paths in 3D Side Platform Obby Draw Pencil! Draw paths with your pencil across the gaps between platforms to help your character move forward safely. Overcome different obstacles in each level, draw the right path, and reach the finish without falling. This fun adventure may look simple, but it requires focus, precision, and perfect timing.
instructions: Jump with W and move left and right using the A and D keys. Mobile touch controls are also available.

title: Berryflow
description: Drag through berries of one color and the juice pours into a glass. There are fewer glasses than colors, so mixing is unavoidable: pour top layers from glass to glass, drop a fizz tablet to foam away a layer, add syrup to blend colors, and bring every mocktail to one pure color. 70 levels across five worlds: chameleon berries, fuses, color bombs, ice and an order belt. No timers, one-hand play on
instructions: Mouse or touch. Drag through 3+ adjacent berries of one color to pour their juice into the selected glass; longer chains give more juice. Tap a glass to choose where the juice goes; above it you see the target color and how much still fits. Drag from glass to glass to pour the top layer (only onto the same color or an empty glass). Fizz removes the top layer; syrup blends the two top layers. A gla

title: Beach Volleyball Clash: Summer Smash
description: Spike, dive and block your way to victory on a sunny beach! Beach Volley Clash is a fast arcade volleyball game you can play against the computer, with a friend on one keyboard, in 2v2 to 4v4 team matches with AI teammates, or online with friends. Hit glowing orbs to charge Fireball, Ice Ball and Multiball super throws, and earn coins to unlock new characters and ball skins.
instructions: A / D to move, W to jump (hold at the top to block), S to spike in the air or dive on the sand, Space to serve. Player 2: arrow keys, Up to jump, Down to spike. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.

title: Arrow Out
description: Arrow Out is a calm, satisfying puzzle game about reading the board. Every level is a shape built from dozens of tangled arrows. Tap an arrow and it slides off the board along its own path, but only if the lane ahead of its tip is clear. Tap a blocked arrow and it crashes, costing you a heart. Clear every arrow to finish the shape.
instructions: Tap or click an arrow to send it out. It only leaves if nothing blocks the lane in front of its tip. Scroll or pinch to zoom, and drag to move around the board. Use Hint, Bomb and Reveal when you're stuck.

title: Arrows Flow
description: Untangle winding arrows and clear the board in Arrows Flow. Each arrow can leave only in the direction it points. Find an open path, click or tap to send it away, and create space for the next move. Learn the controls through an interactive tutorial, then solve increasingly challenging boards with helpful power-ups. Play with a mouse or touch controls.
instructions:
Desktop: Click an arrow with the left mouse button to move it in the direction it points. Click the on-screen buttons to pause or use available power-ups.

Mobile: Tap an arrow to move it in the direction it points. Tap the on-screen buttons to pause or use available power-ups.

Find unblocked arrows and clear the board.

title: Pharaoh Runner: Ancient Escape
description: Embark on an exhilarating endless dash through ancient Egypt in Pharaoh Runner: Ancient Escape! Take control of an agile young adventurer sprinting across majestic temple pathways and ancient ruins. Dodge pottery traps, leap over deadly obstacles, and slide beneath sharp swinging ceiling spikes while collecting glowing golden scarab coins.
instructions:
• Desktop Controls:
  - Jump: [Spacebar] or [Up Arrow] / [W]
  - Slide / Fast Drop: [Down Arrow] / [S]
  - Pause: Click the [II] button or press [P]

• Mobile & Tablet Controls:
  - Swipe UP to Jump
  - Swipe DOWN to Slide or Fast Dive from mid-air
  - Tap the top-right Pause button to access options

title: Ocean Blaze
description: Dive into Ocean Blaze, an exciting ocean adventure packed with action, challenges, coins, and high-score gameplay. Navigate the dangerous waters, survive the challenges, collect rewards, and see how far you can go!
instructions: Use the keyboard or on-screen controls to move and play. Avoid obstacles, collect coins, survive as long as possible, and aim for the highest score.

title: Arena Strike Battle
description:
You will have a shootout in the arena with enemies. Choose any weapon, destroy your opponents.
Different types of weapons, characters and arena maps are already waiting, it's going to be hot! No distracting events, just endless gunfights!
Destroy as many opponents as possible to collect glory points and take the first place in the leaderboard.
instructions:
PC Controls:
- Use the arrow keys or WASD keys to move.
- Move the mouse to aim.
- Left-click to fire.

Mobile Controls:
- Use the left blue stick to move.
- Use the right red stick to aim.
- Release the right red stick to fire.

Destroy as many enemies as possible.

title: Arrow Slide
description: Arrow Slide is a satisfying grid-based puzzle where you tap colorful arrow tiles to slide them off the board. Each tile is shaped like a snake with an arrowhead pointing in one direction — tap it and the whole thing slithers along its path until it disappears off the edge. Clear every tile from the board to complete the level, but be careful — if a tile bumps into another and cannot exit, you lose
instructions:
- Tap any arrow tile to slide it in the direction its arrowhead points
- Bent arrows slither snake-style — the body follows the head along its path
- A tile can only exit if its path is clear all the way off the board
- Tapping a blocked tile costs one life and bumps it back
- Clear every tile from the grid to complete the level
- Use Hint to reveal a safe move, or Eraser to remove a blocking tile

title: Cut the Nut
description:
Cut the Nut! Cut ropes, bounce objects, and use clever tricks to guide the nut safely into the squirrel's mouth. Each level brings new challenges that test your timing, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

With adorable animations, satisfying interactions, and tons of brain-teasing fun, Cut the Nut is a charming adventure for players of all ages. Can you help the squirrel grab every nut?
instructions:
PC: Use the mouse
Mobile: Tap to play

title: Sea Survivor
description: Survive endless waves of enemy ships in an epic three-D top-down sea battle. Fire powerful cannons, collect loot, upgrade your ship, and use smart strategy to become the ultimate sea warrior.
instructions:
Controls
PC: Use the mouse to drag and steer your ship, or use W, A, and D / Arrow Keys to move.
Mobile: Use the on-screen joystick to control your ship.

title: GIN RUMMY
description: Gin Rummy is the ultimate classic card game experience, now available offline and solo against a smart AI opponent. Form sets and runs, knock or go gin to score points, and enjoy hours of strategic fun. Install and play now to master this timeless card game!
instructions: Use your mouse to click and select cards from your hand. Drag and drop unwanted cards to the discard pile to remove them. Click the draw pile to pick up a new card. When ready, click the 'Knock' or 'Gin' button to end your turn and score points.

title: Mystic Link
description:
Connect 3 or more matching jewels to clear them!
Each clear uses 1 Move, and the game ends when your Moves reach 0.
Make long chains to create bombs.
Tap bombs or connect them with jewels to activate them.
Create even longer chains to make bombs that restore Moves.
Clear jewels to fill the Skill and Fever gauges.
When a gauge is full, a support skill activates!
instructions: Drag to connect matching jewels.

title: Happy Food Link
description: Happy Food Link is a fun Mahjong Connect game where you match tasty food tiles and connect pairs with paths using up to two turns. Clear the board by finding the right matches and enjoy simple, relaxing puzzles. Play through fun levels, improve your matching skills, and see how quickly you can clear each board.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to select two matching food tiles and connect them with a path using up to two turns. Clear all the tiles from the board to complete the level.

title: Paddle Rush
description: An exciting boat adventure awaits! Avoid obstacles, jump off ramps, and collect coins to purchase upgrades. You can purchase peppers to speed up, anchors to stop, and propellers to reverse.
instructions:
On a phone: buttons
On a PC:
Turn left - L
Turn right - A
Increase speed - Shift
Propeller - S or K
Anchor - Space

title: Arrows Disappear
description:
Rotate to inspect cube structures, tap blocks with arrows pointing to empty space to make them fly off-screen, clear the entire level to master puzzles.
Arrows on block faces dictate the only removal direction, plan sequence to avoid getting stuck; cute pink & green accent cubes, limited moves challenge your brain for addictive 3D dismantling satisfaction!
instructions:
PC Controls:
Mouse drag: Rotate to view cube.
Mouse click: Tap block with arrow to empty space to remove.
Mobile Controls:
Finger drag: Rotate 3D cube structure.
Tap block: Remove if arrow path is clear ahead.

title: 2048 Voxel Worlds
description: 2048 Voxel Worlds is the classic merge puzzle rebuilt in full 3D. Swipe to slide a whole board of lit voxel blocks, merge matching numbers and chase the target cube past 2048. Spend Swap, Blast and Rotate powers, earn coins on every merge, and unlock eleven worlds. Free, no download.
instructions:
GOAL: merge matching numbered blocks until you build the target tile. On a
4x4 board that is 2048, on 5x5 it is 4096, and on 6x6 it is 8192. You can keep
playing past it.

title: Ambidieztro
description:
Control two characters at the same time, one with each hand! Ambidieztro is a unique skill game that challenges your coordination and ambidexterity.
- 1 player, 2 characters
- Independent controls for each hand
- Both characters must collide to advance to the next level
- Boosts ambidexterity and bilateral coordination
instructions:
Left hand: controls character 1 (WASD)
Right hand: controls character 2 (arrow keys)
Restart: TAB

title: Spider Solitaire
description:
Goal: Build King-to-Ace sequences in the same suit to remove them. Clear all 104 cards to win.

Stock Rules:

    Adds 1 card to every tableau.

    Requirement: All tableaus must contain at least one card to use the stock.

    Tip: Only use the stock when no moves remain.

Modes:

    Easy: 1 Suit (Spades)

    Normal: 2 Suits (Spades/Hearts)

    Hard: 4 Suits (All)
instructions: Goal: Build descending sequences from King to Ace in the same suit. Completed runs are removed; clear the entire deck to win.

title: Blankets
description: Blankets is a relaxing yet addictive color sorting puzzle game where every match helps keep a chilly little cat warm and cozy. Match two squares of the same color to clear them from the board and make room for new ones. It starts easy, but every move matters as the board fills up and the challenge keeps growing. How long can you keep the board under control before it fills up?
instructions: Colored squares fall from the top of the board. Click or tap the lane where you want the current square to land, and it will drop into place. Plan your moves carefully to match colors and keep the board from filling up.

title: Jewel Toy Puzzle
description: The toy world is waiting for you! More than just a game — it's a true challenge. Strategize each move, create powerful combinations, earn amazing rewards and keep the fun going! Can you outsmart the game and bring your toys to life?
instructions: Match three or more identical toys to clear them from the board. Use powerful boosters to overcome tricky levels and progress faster. Complete tasks and special events to earn rewards. Play smart, strategize your moves and keep matching!

title: Bubble Hero
description: Become a hero as you pop your way to success with Bubble Hero. Shoot bubbles, collect special items, free the mice and move through 80 addictive levels of excitement with rewards along the way.
instructions:
Free all the adorably animated mice and while you play, test your game skills and have fun with the lively and quirky music.
Bubble Hero will pull you in and have you working your way through 80 varying and challenging levels, each of which includes simple-yet-exciting game play and new opportunities to receive stars and special rewards.

title: Roller Coaster: Obby Race
description:
Race along narrow rails where every turn can be your last. Speed, reaction, and precise minecart control matter here: accelerate, brake, and pass dangerous sections without falling.
Tracks become harder, obstacles get trickier, and each run becomes more intense. Unlock new minecarts, try different routes, and prove you can complete every challenge. Dangerous tracks with sharp turns await you.
instructions:
The goal of the game is to reach the finish, stay on the rails, and complete all dangerous sections. Control your speed, jump in time, interact with objects, and keep your balance on turns.
Controls: on desktop, use WASD to move, Space to jump, E to interact, and LMB to control the camera. On mobile, use touch and swipe.

title: Supermarket Management Simulator
description: Supermarket Management Simulator invites you to become a real store owner and build a busy supermarket from the ground up! If you enjoy Supermarket management games and creative business challenges, this colorful supermarket adventure is ready for you! With simple controls and endless upgrade possibilities, this game creates a relaxing experience for fans of business simulation games.
instructions: heck customer needs, restock shelves with popular items, and make sure your supermarket always has enough products available. Prepare ingredients like milk and yeast powder to make fresh bread and provide more choices for shoppers.

title: Crazy Marble League
description: Crazy Marble League is a physics-driven marble racing game where marbles battle through wild tracks, hazards, boosts, and finish-line chaos. Place bets, follow the season, and watch your favorite marble fight for the win.
instructions:
Mouse: Click buttons, select marbles, place bets, navigate menus
Touch: Tap buttons, select marbles, place bets, navigate menus

title: Monsters Wheels 2
description: Monsters Wheels 2 is a monster truck game where every event asks something different. Race a packed grid to the finish line, flatten a row of parked cars, land the biggest backflip you can or beat the clock — 24 levels in total, spread across jungles, a beach, an amusement park and the Arizona desert. Three monster trucks are available, each with upgrades for engine, suspension, tyres and nitro. P
instructions:
PC:
Arrow Up / W — accelerate
Arrow Down / S — brake and reverse
Arrow Left / Right — lean back and forward in the air
Space / X — nitro
Mobile:
Acceleration - automatic
Nitro button - Nitro
Tilt buttons - rotate left/right

title: Goose Rescue: Screw Sort
description: Goose Rescue: Screw Sort is a colorful puzzle game where every move brings you closer to freeing the trapped goose! Unscrew the wooden pieces blocking the cage and watch the screws fall into the area below. Remove all the wooden pieces, complete the level, and rescue the goose!
instructions: Tap the colored screws to unscrew them from the wooden pieces. Removed screws fall to the bottom, where two screws of the same color merge and disappear. Choose your moves carefully to avoid running out of space. Keep removing screws to release the wooden pieces one by one. Clear all the obstacles and free the goose to complete the level!

title: Blocky Run
description: Every second pushes you forward. It’s not about where you're going, it’s how long you can last. With danger at every turn and the cop right behind you, there’s no room for mistakes. Jump sharp, use power-ups wisely and unlock every look this world has to offer.
instructions: Tap to jump and avoid everything in your path. Earn coins to get new skins and use boosters like the jetpack, immortality or double jump to gain a temporary edge. The terrain is endless and unforgiving. Miss your timing and you’re done, unless you revive.

title: Needle in a Haystack
description:
Needle In A Haystack is a first-person 3D game about exactly what it says. In front of you is a
pile of 1.5 million straws of hay, and somewhere inside it are ten needles. Find them all as fast
as you can.

Walk into the pile and the world closes in: the hay surrounds you, the light dies, and
the only thing guiding you is a hot-and-cold detector that ticks faster the closer you get. Every
needle y
instructions:
WASD / Arrows
Click on the needle to collect them

title: PixelTris
description: A falling-block puzzle where every piece shatters into flowing sand. Bridge one colour wall to wall to clear it, then chain combos.
instructions:
HOW TO PLAY
• Blocks fall, then shatter into loose sand when they land
• Connect one colour of sand from the left wall to the right wall to clear it
• Clear again within 3 seconds to build a combo multiplier
• Sand piles up as you go — the run ends when there's no room for a new block

CONTROLS
• Move — Left/Right arrows, or A / D
• Rotate — Up arrow, W, or X
• Soft drop — Down arrow, or S
• Hard

title: 3D Supermarket Tycoon
description: 3D Supermarket Tycoon is a relaxing idle supermarket management game where you build and grow your own store. Stock shelves, serve customers, collect cash and expand your business from a small market into a supermarket and hypermarket. Hire cashiers and stock clerks, unlock new shelves and upgrade your store, prices, speed and customer traffic. Build your supermarket empire and become a successful
instructions:
Desktop: Move with WASD or arrow keys. Press E to open upgrades.
Mobile: Tap and drag anywhere to move.
Pick up boxes in the stockroom, walk to a shelf to restock it, and collect the cash at the checkout. Stand on price tags on the floor to unlock shelves and hire staff.

title: Void Tapper Clicker
description: VoidTapper is a dark fantasy incremental clicker where every tap strikes a creature from the void. Target moving weak points, build powerful combos, unleash Overdrive, and upgrade your Power, Drones, and Profit to overcome increasingly dangerous enemies. Fight through five unique worlds, choose skills that shape four different combat builds, defeat timed bosses, unlock achievements, and Prestige f
instructions:
Tap or click the enemy in the center of the screen to attack. Strike moving weak points for bonus damage, maintain your combo, and charge the Overdrive meter for a temporary power boost.

Use earned coins to improve your tap Power, unlock automatic Drones, and increase your Profit. Choose new skills as you progress and combine them into Critical, Combo, Drone, or Overdrive builds.

title: Turbo Horizon Racing
description: Turbo Horizon Racing is a retro arcade racing game inspired by the golden era of 1990s racing games. Before fully polygonal 3D graphics became the standard, racers relied on clever pseudo-3D visuals, fast gameplay, colorful tracks, and pure arcade excitement. Turbo Horizon Racing brings back that classic racing era with modern polish.
instructions:
WASD to move
shift- nitro

title: War Space
description:
warspace.io is a multiplayer .io game about planets, stars and galaxy.

You control a planet that grows by devouring food, debris, and rival players.
Split into pieces to strike, shed mass to escape, and time your merges carefully.
instructions:
How to Play

Mouse     │ Move
Left click │ Aim & fire
Wheel   │ Zoom
Space   | Split
W          │ Eject mass
F           │ Fire
Q          │ Swap weapon
K          │ Voice chat
M          | Mute
Enter    │ Chat
Esc       │ Pause

title: Tower Smash: Can Blaster
description: Aim, shoot, and blast through challenging structures in this thrilling physics-based 3D cannon game! Take control of a powerful cannon, target weak spots in stacked blocks and cans, and knock them all down using limited shots. Plan your angles carefully, trigger massive chain reactions, and clear every level to test your aiming precision and strategy.
instructions:
Aim: Click and drag the mouse (or swipe on mobile) to adjust the cannon's angle and trajectory.

Shoot: Release or click the fire button to launch the cannonball.

Objective: Knock down all blocks and cans off the platforms before running out of shots.

title: Ciallo World
description: Ciallo World is a single-player poker roguelike. Each round you draw 8 cards, play 1 to 5 of them as a poker hand and try to reach the target score with a limited number of plays and discards. Clear the round and recruit one of three programming-language girls; their skills trigger on every hand and stack into wild multipliers. Every 4th round is a boss with its own rule, and every cleared round a
instructions: Mouse or touch. Click cards to select them, then Play or Discard. One click for everything.

title: Cannon Launch
description: Launch your character across the futuristic skyline in Cannon Launch: Overdrive Ultra! Aim your cannon, fire, and bounce across dynamic terrain. Collect coins and rare diamonds mid-air to unlock unique animal heroes, cool custom hats, and distinct biomes. Hit explosive TNT crates, ride rocket rings, and unleash Ultra Overdrive mode to travel massive distances!
instructions: Use Mouse Click or Spacebar to aim/launch and trigger air boosts. Press 'S' to open the store.

title: Arrow Parking
description: Arrow Parking is a relaxing puzzle game that challenges players to think ahead. Place arrow tiles to create the perfect route, guide the car to the garage, and solve increasingly challenging parking puzzles.
instructions:
How to play:

Desktop

Mouse: Drag and drop arrow tiles onto the board.

Mobile

Touch: Drag and drop arrow tiles onto the board.

title: Detective Ava: Logic Files
description: Step into the stylish world of Detective Ava: Logic Files! Read every clue, study the suspects, and use pure deduction to uncover the truth. Mark suspects as Possible or Not Possible, avoid costly mistakes, and solve 90 increasingly challenging cases. Use hints when you’re stuck and prove you have what it takes to close every case.
instructions: Read the clues carefully and compare them with the suspects’ visible features and names. Use the Tick button to mark a suspect as Possible and the Cross button to mark them as Not Possible. Make the correct final deduction to solve the case. You have 3 hearts per level; each mistake removes 1 heart. Lose all 3 hearts and the case ends. Use Hint if you need help.

title: Cocoon Crossing
description: Cocoon Crossing 3D is a relaxing 3D routing puzzle. Drag the head or tail of each caterpillar and it crawls, tile by tile, toward the cocoon of its own color — reach it and it turns into a butterfly. Worms can't cross on the same level, but at a crossing they can climb over a bridge or slip under a tunnel. Solve each board within the move budget, chase the par star, and untangle your way through d
instructions: Drag the head or tail of a caterpillar to make it crawl one tile at a time toward its matching cocoon. Two worms can't overlap on the same level — at a crossing tile, send one over a bridge and the other under a tunnel. Get every worm home (they turn into butterflies) to win. Finish within the move budget; match par for a star. Use Undo to take back a move, or Hint when you're stuck.

title: Chainline: Swing & Climb
description: Chainline is a tactile physics arcade game where momentum, timing and nerve are everything! Slingshot your critter from peg to peg up an endless vertical course. Steer past razor-sharp sawblades, collect candy coins and chain near-miss grazes to charge Hyper Fever. Unlock 8 critters with unique powers, ropes and trails in the Toy Workshop. Spin the Lucky Wheel, keep your daily streak alive, comple
instructions:
Desktop: 
Drag & release (mouse) = slingshot launch. 
Hold Space/W = charge
A/D or arrows = aim while charging. 
A/D or arrows = steer mid-air. 
Hold Shift = slow-mo. 
Double-click = activate Shield Stash. 
R = retry, 
Esc = pause, 
F = fullscreen. Click = menus & UI.

Mobile: 
Drag down & release = launch. Drag mid-air = steer. Drag while attached = reel in. Double-tap = activate Shield Stash. Ta

title: Brain Jam
description: Brain Jam is a sliding car puzzle with one twist: it counts the calories your brain burns while you think. The parking lot is jammed. Slide the cars out of the way and drive the red one to the exit. Every second you spend thinking feeds a live calorie counter, and the longer you concentrate without moving a car, the faster it climbs. 120 hand-checked levels, plus a Daily Puzzle that is the same fo
instructions: Drag a car along its own lane to move it. Cars only slide forward and backward, never sideways. Clear a path and slide the red car out through the exit on the right. Stuck? Tap Hint and the game shows you the next useful move. Mouse: drag. Touch: drag.

title: 2048 Decks
description:
Drag, and the whole board shifts one cell — not as far as it can go. Two equal numbers double only when the tile in front has nowhere left to move, so every merge is one you set up.
Nothing is random. The tiles come off a written deck you can count, and the next three are already on screen, so a jam two moves away is one you can see coming.
Four decks: plain numbers, stones that block until you cr
instructions:
Stack the numbers up. Do not fill the board.
Mouse and touch play the same: drag the board. Arrow keys and WASD work too. Z undoes. Escape or P pauses.

title: Tube Jam Puzzle
description:
Take control of colorful tube dispensers and master the flow of rolling balls in this unique conveyor puzzle challenge. Press and hold to release balls onto the moving belt, fill matching boxes, and keep the conveyor running smoothly.

But be careful! The conveyor has limited capacity. Release too many balls at once and traffic starts to build. Time your flow, switch between tubes, and prevent jam
instructions: Tap and hold the left mouse button on tubes to dispense the balls.

title: Turnline Atelier
description: Turnline Atelier is a tactile logic game about tuning a precision workshop. Rotate routing modules, send workpieces through paint, cutting, assembly, and packing stations, then run the line and watch the result. Master 15 handcrafted commissions across three chapters. Later orders ask you to preserve offcuts, synchronize branches, and assemble parts in the correct sequence.
instructions: Tap or click round routing modules to rotate them. Connect the source, required stations, and destination in recipe order, then press Run. On later levels, route both branches to their matching assembly sockets or parts bins.

title: ECHO
description:
Every move comes back. Drag a ball and it slides one square — then, every three
turns, every ball you have moved repeats its move. Forever. Balls smash gems of
their own colour, so you are never just solving a puzzle: you are building a
machine out of your own past, and then watching it work. Line several balls up
to strike on the same beat and the whole board goes off at once. 160 levels,
every o
instructions:
Drag a ball to move it one square. Every 3 turns, EVERY ball you moved repeats
its move — the brass dial at the top counts down to the next beat. Balls break
gems of their own colour. Break them all before your moves run out.
Press WAIT to skip a turn and let your machine do the work. ERASE removes one
echo if you change your mind.
Desktop: drag with the mouse, or tap a ball and use the arrow keys

title: SUMI
description:
You are a ball.
There are other balls.
You have to shoot them.

Survive. Get stronger. Go further. And most importantly get the highest score you possibly can.

Designed to be simple, relaxing, and easy to pick up, but surviving for a long time won't be quite as easy as it seems.

How long can you survive?
instructions:
Move: WASD
Shoot: Hold the Left Mouse Button
Pause: P, Esc
Goal: Destroy enemies, survive as long as possible, and get the highest score.

title: Duck Family Simulator Animal Games
description: Experience the exciting life of a wild duck in Duck Family Simulator Animal Games! Explore beautiful islands, peaceful lakes, and lush green forests while raising your duck family and surviving against dangerous predators. Hunt for food, protect your ducklings, complete thrilling missions, and discover the adventures of life in the wild.
instructions:
Desktop:
AWSD: Player Movement
Mouse = Camera Movement
P = Pause
Ctrl = Setting
I = Info
E = Attack
Shift = Sprint
F = Actions
U: Click to fly
J: Click for walk
E: Move up while flying
X: Move Down while flying

Mobile:
Joystick to Move Player
Drag Screen

title: Hotpot Loop Sort
description: Food‑sorting puzzle challenge to test your reaction skills. Beneath its charming visuals lies a real brain workout. Plan your hotpot strategy, manage conveyor capacity and pull off perfect combinations. Sorting pushes your multi‑tasking skills to the limit. Loops speed up, more dishes pour in, and tension keeps rising
instructions:
Tap and flip ingredients, place them onto the conveyor belt.
Match ingredient hints from the hotpot and time your drop precisely.
Never overload the conveyor or place wrong items.
Adapt to more ingredients to beat levels.

title: Bubble Pillar
description:
Immerse yourself in a world of classic arcade games, reimagined in a new D format!
This isn't just another "bubbles" game — it's a puzzle where the playing field is located on the surface of a tower, and the space is enclosed in a circle. Here, every trajectory matters, and every shot can be part of a brilliant combo.
Enjoy beautiful graphics, pleasant sounds, and the unique atmosphere of three di
instructions:
Rotate the tower, aim, and shoot!
Your goal — clear the tower of all bubbles.

 PC Controls:
• Hold the right mouse button and move the cursor to rotate the tower.
• Click the left mouse button to shoot.

 Mobile Controls:
• Swipe along the bottom of the screen to rotate the tower.
• Hold your finger on the playing field to aim.
• Release your finger — and the bubble flies!

title: Bestie Sleepover Party

In each level, you are tasked with placing a specific number of animals (such as pigs) onto a color-coded grid. To solve the puzzle, you must satisfy the following logic rules:

•	Color Regions: Every distinct colored area on the grid must contain exactly one animal.
•	No Neighbors: Animals cannot be placed in adjacent cells (no touching allowed).

Score more goals than your opponent before time runs out. Move, jump, and strike the ball with perfect timing while using your supershot to surprise your opponent and gain the advantage.

Move: A / D or Left / Right Arrow Keys
Jump: W or Up Arrow Key
Slide: S or Down Arrow Key
Shot: X or L
Supershot: Z or K

title: Fruit Merge Arena
description: Fruit Merge Arena is a fun and relaxing game where you drop fruits and merge the same ones to create bigger fruits. Keep merging step by step and try to reach the ultimate fruit — the watermelon! But be careful, space is limited and the board can fill up quickly. Plan your moves wisely and keep merging to stay in the game.Feeling stuck or running out of space? Don’t worry! You can watch a reward ad to remove all instances of a selected fruit and make room for new moves.

title: Jump to the Mountain for the Brainrots
description:
You'll play as Obby, a character located on a tall mountain.
Various Brainrots will randomly appear on the mountain, guarded by enemies.
Your task is to jump up the mountain and rescue the Brainrots. Collect the entire Brainrot collection without falling into enemy hands!
Sell Brainrots to increase your jump height and reach the very top of the mountain. Rare Brainrot species live at the very top.
instructions:
PC Controls:
WASD - Move
Right mouse button - rotate camera
Space - Jump
Left mouse button - Pick Up Brainrot

Phone Controls:
Left Joystick - Move
Swipe Right Side of Screen - Rotate Camera
On-screen buttons: Jump and grab a Brainrot.

Collect the entire Brainrot collection. Take first place on the leaderboard.

title: Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY
description: Welcome to Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY, the ultimate playground for those who love to personalize, design, and express their unique style!
instructions: Dive into the colorful world of custom art and transform ordinary phone cases into extraordinary masterpieces. Whether you're a seasoned artist or just looking for a fun way to unleash your creative side, this game offers endless possibilities to craft the phone case of your dreams.

title: Theo Morini's Magical Resort
description:
“Theo Morini’s Magical Resort” is a magical, romantic, and captivating merge puzzle game about rebuilding a resort on an enchanted island.

Talented writers and actors created this story and brought its characters to life. Enjoy the story!
instructions:
1. Merge items: drag matching items together on the board to create a higher-level item. The higher the level, the more valuable it is for completing orders and making progress.

2. Complete orders: choose from the available orders, collect the required items, and submit them to earn gold coins.

3. Get new items: as you progress, new producer icons will appear. Tap them, spend Sparks, and receive new items.

title: Word Stars
description: Find hidden words and piece together your success. Each puzzle is a step towards mastering the game and expanding your word power. Use hints to keep progressing. From the first word to the last, it’s a race to finish all the levels.
instructions: Letters are scattered on the board. The goal is to create words to fill the number of empty spaces above. If you need help to keep moving forward, hints are available. Enjoy relaxing backgrounds as you progress through the levels.

title: Tank Challenge
description:
Tank Challenge is an action-packed tank battle game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Play solo or challenge a friend in fast-paced matches.

Defeat your opponent using powerful weapons like lasers, triple bullets, bomb shells, and rockets.

Make quick decisions, aim carefully, and stay ahead to win. Smooth on mobile and desktop, easy to learn but challenging to master.

Enter the arena and fight for victory!
instructions:
1 PLAYER MODE
- Move: Arrow Keys
- Shoot: M

2 PLAYER MODE
Player 1
- Move: WASD
- Shoot: V

Player 2
- Move: Arrow Keys
- Shoot: M

Mobile: Touch Controls

title: The Noob Aventures
description:
The Noob Adventures invites you to join a dangerous journey through a colorful world full of action, traps, and enemies. Travel across challenging lands in search of diamonds and overcome all obstacles. Complete 70 levels packed with danger and surprises as you fight enemies determined to stop your progress. Rescue the friends, survive the challenges along the way, and prove that even a noob can become a true hero.
Collect diamonds and unlock new characters to continue your adventure
instructions: Use the keyboard or screen buttons to play

title: Goodeluxe
description: Goo Deluxe is a Collapse game with a sticky and satisfying aesthetic. It's a simple and relaxing game. Unlike other Goobox games, Goo Deluxe is not limited by time, allowing you all the time to think. Isn't that true luxury?
instructions:
Eliminate the Goos in groups of two or more by clicking on them.
Eliminating an isolated Goo will cost you a dose of poison. After six, it's game over!
Plan your moves ahead to group the Goos and eliminate them more efficiently.

title: SuperPixelint
description:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?
instructions:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?

title: Pixel Flow
description: Come to train your brain with colors and paths. Pixel Flow is a clean and addictive pixel puzzle game that challenges your logic and planning skills. In each level, you must send kittens of different colors into the track. Pixel points matching the kittens' colors will be eliminated. Paths cannot cross or overlap, so every move matters.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Smash Defense
description: Smash Defense is a chaotic baseball-inspired action game where your swings decide the fate of entire worlds. Crush waves of flying monsters using your bat and evolve your ball with fiery, electric, and explosive powers. Travel through dynamic environments like deep oceans and erupting volcanoes, upgrade your skills, and prove you’re the ultimate monster-slaying champion.
instructions: ControlsWASD / Arrows keys / mouse = movement

title: Merge Home Mania
description: Welcome to an exciting game where creativity meets strategy! Merge items, build unique structures and decorate your perfect home. Use materials like stone, wood, textiles, flowers and plants to create furniture and decorations. Design beautiful rooms and show off your decorating talent!
instructions: Build your home by fusing three or more identical objects to create greater fusions. Deposit your final fusion to earn unique rewards! Collect coins, special chests, bags and keys while gaining experience points to unlock new islands. Continue your adventure by building more complex structures!

title: Jewel Link
description:
Connect matching jewels and clear the board! In Jewel Link, a Connect2 game inspired by Bejeweled, your goal is simple: find two identical jewels and link them together to make them disappear. 

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging and trickier. Placements will test your ability to think ahead and spot Connect-2 connections quickly. It’s not just about what you see - it’s about how you navigate the board to match the jewels.
instructions:
Match two identical jewels to remove them from the board. It sounds simple, but there's a catch: the connecting line can't have more than three turns, meaning you can make a maximum of three corners in the path. Too many bends, and the connection won't work.

Therefore, you must look closely, find a clear route, and plan your moves in advance. The most effective jewel links are often those you least expect!

title: Water Sort Puzzle 3
description: Face a super satisfying liquid sorting challenge with Water Sort Puzzle 3! This addictive puzzle game turns simple color sorting into a relaxing yet brain-teasing experience you won’t want to stop playing! This game is perfect for those who enjoy calm but clever challenges. It trains your logic while keeping the experience relaxing and fun. As a true casual game, it’s ideal for quick breaks and time killing, making every moment feel satisfying and rewarding!
instructions: Click/drag to play.

title: Island Expander
description:
Island Expander — relaxing crafting game. Collect resources, discover 30+ recipes, and grow your island step by step!
It is a cozy crafting game where you transform a tiny island into a paradise.
Collect resources, unlock recipes, craft items — from simple tools to complex machines — and watch your island grow with every step.

Start building your dream island today! ?
instructions:
Control your character using mouse and keyboard:
Mouse — look around
LMB — hit / use tool
Keys 1–4 — switch tools
Tab — open inventory
E — interact with objects
ESC — pause menu
Left ALT / Right Alt - Unlock Mouse
Gather resources, craft items, and expand your island step by step.

title: Terra Craft World
description: Terra Craft World invites you to explore an open world where every decision shapes your journey. Begin an unforgettable adventure filled with discovery and creativity. This game perfectly blends exploration, building, and survival mechanics into one exciting experience. Whether you enjoy creating structures or overcoming environmental dangers, every moment feels rewarding and dynamic. Discover more craft and building experiences packed with creativity and exploration fun!
instructions:
On PC: WASD to move.
On Mobile: Click the on-screen button to operate.

title: Springle Puzzle
description: Springle Puzzle is a fun and fast jigsaw game where you solve puzzles before time runs out. Choose from styles like Classic, Irregular, Hexagon, or Wave, each with a different feel. Play easy mode with fewer pieces for a quick game and lower score, or pick more pieces for a harder challenge and higher score. If time runs out, watch a reward ad and keep playing.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to drag the piece and join it to another

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.
instructions: Tap two identical tiles to connect and remove them. A pair can be matched only if a path of no more than three straight lines (up to two turns) can be drawn between them through empty cells. Clear all tiles to finish the level. Use hints or shuffle when you get stuck.

title: 67 Clicker
description:
Forget everything you know about gaming. Experience the absolute peak of interactive entertainment. It’s not just a number; it’s a lifestyle. Tap the 67 and watch your empire grow.

FULLY AUTOMATED STONKS: Buy upgrades to make the 67 click itself. It’s literally free real estate.

PEAK BRAIN ROT: No thoughts, just 67. The perfect idle experience for fans of "number go up" simulators.
instructions:
Click the 67 in the middle of the screen.
Buy upgrades using the buttons at the bottom of the screen.

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: Push.io
description: Push.io is a fast-paced arena game where you battle to stay on the map and push everyone else off. Wield your boomerang with precision to knock rivals into the water while dodging incoming attacks. The longer you survive, the higher you rank; fall early, and you’ll drop in the standings. Earn trophies, upgrade your boomerang between rounds, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate arena champion.
instructions:
Desktop: 
- WASD or mouse = move
- Space bar or left mouse button = attack

Mobile: 
- Joystick = move
- Button = attack

title: Bubble Sky
description: Bubble Sky is an ascending Bubble Shooter game that will take you to dizzying heights. Will you be able to reach space? Reach a score of 200000 points to unlock the wheel of fortune and win collectible cards to complete your album!
instructions:
Aim with the mouse and click to shoot a bubble. Aim at clusters of the same color to make them fall. Clusters must consist of at least 3 bubbles of the same color. The more big clusters you make fall, the faster your bonus gauge fills up. When the gauge is full, you get a period of time during which your bubbles destroy all colors, take advantage of it to pop many bubbles and reach the maximum height.
If the bubbles reach the bottom of the screen, it's game over, don't look down!

title: Hidden Objects Island
description: Discover the ultimate hidden objects game and embark on a journey through stunning locations, captivating puzzles, and mysterious adventures!
instructions:
The goal of the game is to find all the hidden objects in the locations.
PC control - left-click on a hidden object
Control on a mobile device - tap on a hidden object

Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!
instructions: Press up (or W) to accelerate, use left (or A) and right (or D) to tilt your bike, and press backwards (or S) to brake. Watch your surroundings and pay attention to all traffic signs! Get out of the sand by tapping the forward button or unlock that special bike. Good luck!

title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots is a fast and rewarding collection game where action, risk, and strategy come together. Your mission is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and safely deliver them to your base before time runs out. Each run is a mix of decision making and reflex.

Hit: Left Mouse Click or F
Jump: Space
Pick Up or Sell: E
Rebirth: T
Egg Index: H

description: Solve funny brain puzzles by moving the arrow and finding the correct path. Each level challenges your logic, reflexes, and creativity in a light and addictive way.

You can jump further if you press down on the marker.
Press and release the timing so that it doesn't fall between the footrest and the footrest!

title: Dice Puzzle
description: Dice Puzzle is a smart, satisfying merge game where you place numbered dice on a grid to combine matches and build higher values. Plan ahead, manage limited space, and handle dice that appear solo or in pairs. Every move matters—chain merges, grow your numbers, and test your strategy in this addictive dice challenge.
instructions: Choose a die (or pair) from the tray and drag it onto the grid. Tap dice in the tray to rotate them (great for pairs). When 3+ dice with the same face connect, they auto-merge into one higher-value die. Matches can merge in lines and also when touching diagonally. Use storage slots to save dice for later.

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.
instructions: Simply tap the cannons to put them on the conveyor belt.

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 7: and Friends
description:
Fireboy and Watergirl need help to explore this new temple. This time with 3 new friends that will help them solve the puzzles, beat the times and collect all the diamonds! 

Play alone or with a friend to join Fireboy and Watergirl in this new adventure!

Turn levers and push buttons to complete these 36 new levels of the official Fireboy and Watergirl series.
instructions: Use AWD to move Watergirl, use the Arrow keys to move Fireboy, use GYJ to move the Friends. Complete all levels fast enough and grabbing all the diamonds to get a perfect score.

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Street of Secrets is an atmospheric hidden object game where you become the lead detective. A mysterious case awaits, and your insightful assistant is there to help, offering hints and guiding you to crucial details.
instructions: Explore each scene: pan left and right, zoom in to examine details, and find all the items on your list. The game is fully optimized for both PC and mobile devices, so you can play anytime, anywhere.

title: Savage Defenders
description: A tower defense strategy action game where you become the last hope of a tribe living at the foot of an ancient volcano. When an asteroid with an alien threat falls to the planet, you must combine magic, tactics and the strength of warriors to stop the invader who is devouring all life.
instructions:
Game Objective:

Defend the village from alien invaders using tactics, magic and the power of warriors. Don't let the enemies break through to the heart of the settlement!

Main Mechanics:

Build towers - place archers, spearmen, stone throwers and shamans at strategic points on the map.
Improve defense - spend resources to strengthen towers and unlock new abilities.

title: Grow a Garden 3D
description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! ?
Explore different seasons, customize your character, and watch your garden grow bigger every day.
Every seed is special and every garden is unique!

Buttons for Picking up item and Planting also for Other such as Jumping

Thre game has an In-game Tutorial which Guide the player.

Reach the end and find out all the secrets! Support us by leaving a review and comment! If you have any comments or suggestions, please describe them and we will try to make improvements quickly!
