title: Farm Blast
description: Farm Blast is a colorful level-based blast puzzle game set on a vibrant farm. Complete exciting objectives, overcome tricky obstacles, and unlock powerful boosters as you progress through hundreds of engaging levels. With bright visuals, satisfying chain reactions, and strategic gameplay, this addictive casual puzzle game is perfect for fans of match-3 games, farm games, and relaxing yet challenging brain teasers.
instructions: Tap on 2 or more adjacent identical fruits to remove them from the board. Complete the level objective shown at the top before you run out of moves. Larger groups create stronger blasts and special boosters. Clear obstacles by matching items next to them and use boosters wisely to beat challenging levels and achieve higher scores.

title: Fruit Sort Logic
description: Fruit Sort Logic is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you sort colorful fruit juices on shelves. Move the juices around and match three of the same kind to clear a shelf. Space is limited, so each move matters. Clear all shelves to finish the level and unlock new ones. With smooth controls, bright visuals, and endless levels, the game is easy to play and satisfying to master. Perfect for a calm but clever puzzle experience.
instructions: Move fruit juice items between shelves and match three identical juices to clear a shelf. Plan each move carefully because space is limited. Clear all shelves to complete the level and continue unlocking new sorting challenges.

title: Avenger Guard
description: Dark forces have destroyed your homeland—rise as the Avenger Guard! Merge heroes to unlock power, fortify defenses, and take vengeance. Lead your legendary squad to repel waves of enemies, upgrade through fusion, and reclaim what’s yours. Will you be the last line of defense?
instructions:
Merge identical heroes to unlock stronger versions with unique abilities.​
Place heroes strategically on the battlefield to block enemy advances.​
Collect resources from battles to upgrade your squad and defenses.​
Repel all enemy waves to complete levels and uncover the revenge storyline.

title: Accurate 2D
instructions:
In this game, the player must complete all levels by shooting at his enemies.

Controls:
• Press the screen, without releasing the press, aim at the enemies, release the press to shoot.

title: 2048 Block Fusion
description:
"2048 Block Fusion" is not just 2048. This is a new generation of numerical puzzles where blocks fall, merge, increase their values and unlock unexpected possibilities!

Choose one of the three modes:
Adventures — complete levels, unlock special blocks and solve problems with a limited number of moves.
Advanced — endless mode with bonuses and special blocks for those who love freedom and strategy.
Classic — familiar mechanics without unnecessary elements, for the pure pleasure of merging.
instructions:
Click on the column to place the active block.
Combine blocks with the same values.
In the "Adventure" and "Advanced" modes:
- when merging 3 or more blocks, all similar ones on the field also increase their values!
- Collect coins — they are credited to your account and help in the game.

In Adventure mode:
- Complete the level objectives in a limited number of steps.
- Use hints if you get stuck.

Use the bonuses:
- deleting a block
- swapping places
- increase the value by 2 times

title: Word Cross
description:
Word Cross is an excellent way to loosen up and relax your mind.
Find as many hidden words as you can and improve your vocabulary everyday!

Word Cross combines classic crossword with a modern twist, offering hours of fun and brain-boosting challenges.

► Features:
     ◆ 6000+ challenging levels.
     ◆ Well designed grass & wooden theme.
     ◆ Dictionary: Expand your vocabulary!
     ◆ Hint and other boosters: magnifying glasses, firecrackers.
     ◆ No time limit, no pressure.
instructions:
Find all the hidden words that fit into the crossword grid to win a level.

How to Play: 
- Look at the letters in the circle.
      . Swipe the mouse across the letters to form a word.
      . You can swipe in any direction.
      . Release your finger to submit the word.
      . If the word is correct, it will fill into the grid.
- Keep forming words until the entire grid is complete.

title: Neon Dash: Cyber Run
description:
Neon Dash: Cyber Run is a high-speed endless runner set in a glowing cyber world.
Jump over deadly spikes, pass through portals to shift themes, and survive as
the game speed increases over time.

The game is designed for short, replayable sessions with instant restarts.
Perfect for both desktop and mobile players.
instructions:
Tap / Click / Space – Jump
ESC / P – Pause
Avoid red spikes and survive as long as possible.

title: Brainrot World Hole.io
description: Brainrot World Hole.io is a hilarious casual hole game packed with chaotic brainrot energy and funny Italian meme vibes. Control a growing hole and dive into a crazy world where swallowing everything in sight is the key to victory. Move around the map and collect objects smaller than your hole.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Nubik: Create Your Place
description:
Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

The game features many skins for Nubiks, achievements, a leaderboard, and chat.
instructions:
Game controls: WASD or ←, →, ↑, ↓, where S or ↓ is used to shoot. In single-player mode, you can choose any of these options.

When you get bored, be sure to click "Delete the Game" to get the in-game currency you earned while playing.

title: Stardom Alt-Girls Fashion Duel
description: Welcome to the world of daring alternative glamour! Meet two star heroines - Sydney and Sabrina. Help them go beyond the usual and try on the most daring alternative images: from a gentle soft-grunge princess to a gloomy rock diva. In the game, you can make bright makeup with arrows and sparkles; create unusual hairstyles; collect memorable outfits from tops, corsets, mini skirts and oversized jackets. Create your own collection of stunning Alt-girl looks!
instructions: Help two brave girl friends on their journey through the world of alternative fashion. The result of your stylish experiments can be saved as a screenshot in PNG format to show it to your friends. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

title: Shadowman Runner
description:
Shadowman Runner is a dark, atmospheric endless runner inspired by the minimalist silhouette style of Limbo and the fast-paced arcade spirit of games like Soul Knight and Alto’s Adventure. Set in a mysterious black-and-shadow world, the game challenges your reflexes, timing, and focus.
You play as a lone runner sprinting through a dangerous jungle landscape. Your goal is simple yet addictive: run as far as you can, collect potions to score points, and survive.
instructions: The character is always running, your task is to press to jump. Jump over obstacles.

title: Blockibo: Color Blocks
description:
Blockibo: Color Blocks is a fun and thoughtful puzzle game where every move matters.
Move colorful blocks, unlock gates, overcome obstacles and use boosters to clear the board.
instructions:
Move colorful blocks around the game board
Send blocks into gates and clear the path to the exit
Use boosters to handle difficult situations
Plan your moves — a wrong decision can block your path
Clear the entire board to complete the level
Each level is a new logic challenge where planning and attention to detail matter.

title: Color Wood Animal Jam
description: Begin a charming logic puzzle match game in Color Wood Animal Jam. Drag the colorful wooden animal pieces into their correct spots. Complete each delightful jam puzzle. One wrong move can make the color block jam even trickier.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Stand on the Right Color, Robby!
description: “Stand on the Right Color, Robby!” is a fast arcade race on shifting colored tiles. React to color changes, jump from tile to tile, and stay on the right color to avoid falling. Beat rivals to the finish, earn currency, and unlock fun Robby skins, items, and effects as you climb the leaderboard!
instructions: Move Robby across colored tiles and reach the finish without falling. When colors change, quickly jump to a tile that matches the safe color. PC: WASD or RMB to move, Space/LMB to jump, mouse to look around. Mobile: left joystick to move, button to jump, right joystick to control camera.

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.
instructions: The goal of the game is to identify and destroy all disguised vampires, save the citizens, defeat the Vampire Lord and stop the uprising, freeing the city from the threat.

title: Idle PinBall - Merge Clicker
description: Welcome to an exciting mobile game for those who love to combine elements and enjoy simple but addictive gameplay. Minimalistic 3D graphics, dynamic combinations and the ability to play for free, even without an Internet connection are waiting for you.
instructions: The goal of the game is to combine elements, creating new combinations to earn money, increase passive income and develop your pinball empire. The player gradually unlocks new levels, bonuses and improvements, achieving maximum efficiency and progress.

title: Obby vs Zombies
description: Obby vs Zombies is an innovative, fun-filled action game that captivated the gaming world. It challenges players to create mazes of different characters to fend off hordes of incoming zombies. The wide variety of options for attack and defense make this a highly strategic game with lots of replay value.
instructions: Use the mouse or touch to play

title: Valentines Hidden Alphawords
description: Valentines Hidden Alphawords is a charming and relaxing Valentine’s Day–themed puzzle game where love meets word discovery. Explore beautifully designed romantic scenes filled with hidden letters waiting to be found. Each completed level reveals a sweet and heartwarming caption that perfectly matches the image. With 30 engaging levels, increasing challenges, and a ticking clock with useful hints, the game keeps players entertained while celebrating the spirit of love.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to tap or click on the hidden letters to find and collect them.

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!
instructions:
Player 1 
Movement: W, A, S, D
Jump: Space (Double Jump available)
Change Camera: C
Respawn: R

Player 2 
Movement: Arrow Keys
Jump: K (Double Jump available)
Change Camera: L
Respawn: U

On mobile devices, the game supports single-player mode with intuitive touch controls designed for smooth snowboarding.

title: Police Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome police cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Luxury Highway Cars!
instructions: W, A, S, D/ Arrow Keys: Drive/Steer/Brake , F: Nitro , C: Change Camera

title: Thread Match 2
description:
Thread Match 2 is a satisfying logic puzzle game that combines color matching, layered challenges, and calming embroidery visuals.

Solve clever thread puzzles by planning the correct order of moves and dismantling complex constructions. Each level challenges your brain with blocked and unlocked elements, where strategy and attention matter more than speed.
instructions:
Your goal is to fill the target spools in the center of the screen.

At the bottom, small spools are arranged inside layered constructions. You can only take spools that are unblocked — those not covered by other platforms. Select an available small spool and send it to the matching color target spool.

When a target spool collects three matching spools, it is completed and the thread is automatically sent forward.

Clear all required target spools to complete the level.

title: Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon
description: Build Your Dream Gas Station and Garage Tycoon Empire! Take charge in Gas Station Simulator Inc., the ultimate game for oil tycoon enthusiasts, idle games managers, and aspiring entrepreneurs! Manage, rebuild, and expand the gas station simulator, clean up your junkyard, and fix cars in this immersive and rewarding gas station simulator.
instructions: Keyboard or mouse to move. Mouse to use menu.

title: Valentines Love Link
description: Valentines Love Link is a cute and relaxing matching puzzle game full of hearts, roses, chocolates, and love symbols. Connect matching Valentines items with straight lines, allowing up to two turns. Beat the clock across 48 levels by collecting all tiles and enjoy a sweet romantic theme.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to select tiles and match two same items by linking them with a straight line that can have up to two turns and no blocks in between. Clear all tiles before the time ends to finish the level.

title: Jewels Blitz Legends
description: Embark on a dazzling adventure in Jewels Blitz Legends, the epic sequel to the beloved Match 3 hit! Travel through ancient Inca temples, uncover mystical secrets, and match colorful gems to unlock treasures. Explore Machu Picchu, complete hundreds of challenging levels, and take on exciting daily missions and weekly events. Collect gold, magical artifacts, and experience stunning visuals in this addictive journey through the heart of ancient legend!
instructions: Combine at least 3 shiny gems of the same type to make them vanish. Use their secretive powers to remove jungle obstacles and magical seals. Climb your way up the saga map to increasingly difficult levels.

title: Daily Match
description: Connect tiles with a great number of pictures in pairs within the limited time. As you crush all the tiles on the board, you can win the level! Become a tile master level by level! Play faster and faster to train your brain and exercise the link technology!
instructions: Find two identical tiles without the block of other tiles!

title: Penguin Farm - Ice Merge
description:
Explore a world of frozen islands where penguins run their own farm. Collect resources, merge wood, build and upgrade buildings to open up new territories. Develop your settlement step by step, expand your glaciers, and watch your income grow.
Train your penguins, improve production, and head to the ocean for rewards—there drift chests filled with valuable treasures. Upgrade each building, manage your resources, and turn your small island into a thriving icy farm.
instructions:
Game Objective:
Develop a penguin farm: combine resources, build and upgrade buildings, discover new glaciers, and collect income, turning the island into a thriving settlement.

Controls:
Touch / Left Click — select objects, combine resources, interact with buildings, and collect rewards.

title: Cute cat's adventures
description: An adventure game for girls about a cat, with whom you have to go in search of kittens. Colorful levels await you, filled with traps, obstacles and secrets, as well as dangerous enemies who will try to prevent you from completing your main goal.
instructions: The goal of the game is to go through all the levels, find 3 kittens on each of them and collect all the coins.

title: VR World
description:
If you seen VR games on TikTok where you can manipulate little people like puppets, and you like it, then this is the game for you.

- In the game, you can fight with little people and drag and manipulate them like in a VR game.
- The game runs without any special VR equipment. All you need is a computer or smartphone. It's all in the browser, no downloads required!
- The game offers various jobs, such as police officer and ambulance driver!
instructions:
Controls:
W, A, S, D - Walking.
Mouse - Camera.
E - Menu / Interaction Settings.
Mouse buttons - Interaction.

Smartphone controls: Use the stick to control the character, and use the camera controls on the right side of the screen. To interact with another character, click on the character or drag their limb, depending on the interaction mode. To change the mode, click on the mode change icon.

title: Nautilus Spaceship Escape
description: There is an eerie silence on the Nautilus, an intergalactic spaceship. You have just been asleep when the power goes out for a moment. An uneasy feeling creeps over you - something is wrong here. Could there have been an attack? Get up, explore the surroundings and find out what has happened!
instructions: Use mouse to take items and interact.

title: Italian Animals: Create Your Own Brainrot!
description: Create your own crazy Brainrot! Mix bodies, heads, and legs to create absurd Italian creatures, listen to their "passports" and keep your masterpieces as keepsakes. Creative chaos is in your hands!
instructions:
1. Select the body. Confirm your choice by clicking Done.
2. Select the head and confirm.
3. Select the legs and click Done.
4. Get your own Brainrot's passport.
5. Listen to the name of the resulting Brainrot in Italian.
6. Save the image by clicking the camera button.
7. Click the Rebuild button and build the next Brainrot.
8. Choose from different sets of themed brainrots - Christmas, Halloween, or regular ones.

title: Superheroes and the Wand
description: You will play as a Wand character who had a strange dream about a sorcerer. Soon, in reality, the sorcerer from Stickman dream appears in the city and begins to do evil. Wand, together with the Superheroes, decide to teach the sorcerer a lesson. But not everything is so easy to do. The following superheroes are waiting for you: Blushing, Green Man, Bobo, Cudgel, Bruise, Flyer, Captain Captain and others. Among the enemies will be the Wizard, Anrik, the Clown and others.
instructions:
Use your computer mouse to control the game.
If you have a mobile device, then use the stylus or your finger.
To complete the game, you need to click on different buttons indicated on the screen in the game.
To defeat the enemy, you need to quickly click on the sight.

title: Super Brain
description: In the game, you'll control a character sprinting down a track, but your path is blocked by a series of "Gates of Knowledge." Each gate presents an interesting question, and you must choose the lane corresponding to the correct answer in a short amount of time to pass through. A wrong choice ends the run! As you get faster, the questions become trickier. This game tests not only your knowledge but also your on-the-spot reaction skills. Come join this dual challenge of brain and speed!
instructions:
- Swipe Left/Right : Move your character into the lane that represents the correct answer.
- Make your choice quickly, because your character never stops running!

title: Italian Animal Alchemy - Brainrot
description:
Dive into a world of crazy Italian creatures, where logic meets memes! Combine animals and objects to create the strangest and funniest Italian mutants!
A true meme zoo awaits you here, where creativity knows no bounds! Experiment, discover rare mutants, and share your results with friends to prove you have the most epic brainrot.
instructions: Your goal is to collect the entire Brainrot collection and become a master of Italian madness. Each new fusion is a surprise, a burst of laughter, and a dose of absurdity that will make you unable to tear yourself away.

title: Taylor Dress Studio Preppy & Wild West & Glam
description: Welcome to the dress-up game, in which the pop diva tries on three completely different fashionable looks: a youthful preppy bow, a cowboy outfit and a glamorous stage look. In addition, you can experiment with hairstyles and change the makeup of the heroine. Complete the images with accessories: glasses, hats and jewelry. Choose clothes and combine elements from different sets to create delicate, daring or superstar bows. Turn Taylor into an icon of any style!
instructions: Become a fashion stylist for a popular singer and create three completely unique fashion looks for your ward in three completely different styles. The result of your work can be saved as a screenshot in PNG format to show it to your friends. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

title: Fruit Jam Master
description: Enter the juiciest and most addictive puzzle adventure ever. Enjoy a fun logic puzzle game in Fruit Jam Master. You need to help all the animals leave the grassland to win. Pay attention to the color of the food. Animals can only pass through when the food matches their own color.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration
description: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration invites you into a joyful world of color, tradition, and friendship as you help best friends prepare for the Lunar New Year. Dress them up in beautiful traditional outfits, elegant modern looks, and festive accessories inspired by Chinese New Year celebrations.
instructions: Left mouse button click or Tap to play

title: Summon Tribe
description: Summon Tribe is a simple merge-and-defense game where you combine identical units to create stronger ones to stop enemies. It’s easy, mostly for passing time, and it also supports idle play.
instructions: Merge facilities, traps, and turrets to build the strongest defense. Plan carefully in limited space and defeat your enemies! Choose your skills to boost your defense and find the best combo to survive.

title: Obby Prison Run
description: Obby Prison Run is an intense obstacle course game where escape is the only option—and survival is everything. Sprint, leap, and dodge through deadly traps and twisted takes on classic childhood games. Outsmart your rivals and stay ahead in the race for freedom, where every second counts and only the sharpest make it out alive.
instructions: Use the keyboard or buttons to move

title: Prison Master: Escape Journey
description: Prison Master Escape Journey is a thrilling prison escape simulator that challenges your brain and strategic thinking! Trapped inside a high-security prison, you must plan every move carefully and begin an intense adventure toward freedom.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Remove The Blocks
description: Challenging 3D puzzle game where you strategically clear the blocks from complex formations. Click blocks to slide them out in their facing direction, but choose wisely - each move affects the entire structure. With increasingly difficult levels, time-based scoring, and smooth 3D graphics, test your spatial reasoning skills!
instructions: Remove blocks by clicking them to slide out in their facing direction, clearing the entire structure to complete each level.

title: Steal Brainrot Original 3D
description: Buy rare animals—from the entry-level Nubini Pitzanini to Tralalelo Tralal and Los Tralaleritos. Place them in your base, create ideal conditions, and start earning! Each animal generates income ? and opens the door to new opportunities. Grow your collection, improve your infrastructure, experiment with your team composition, and increase your profits. Want more income? Buy new, rarer animals and build your financial empire.
instructions:
For PC:

-Move using WASD or arrow keys ⬅️⬆️⬇️➡️
-Rotate the camera by moving the mouse while holding the right mouse button
-Interact with animals using the E key
-Jump with the Spacebar

For Mobile:

-Move using the joystick on the left side of the screen
-Rotate the camera by swiping on the right side of the screen
-Interact with animals via the pop-up button above the animal
-Jump using the button on the right side of the screen

title: Hook Pin Jam
description: Hook Jam is an addictive puzzle game where you untangle and release hooks to clear the board and earn rewards. Each level challenges your logic and planning with increasingly complex layouts. Solve puzzles efficiently, unlock new stages, and test your problem-solving skills in this clever, satisfying brain game.
instructions: Tap hooks to release and untangle them. Your goal is to clear all hooks using the fewest moves possible. Each level has a unique puzzle, with special challenges offering bonus rewards. Completing levels earns currency and unlocks harder stages. You have limited lives—wait or watch ads to continue when they run out.

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.
instructions:
Each level has a specific objective — remove nuts of certain colors to complete the level.

At the bottom of the screen, you receive sets of colorful nuts. Drag and drop them onto the game board to place them in empty cells.

When three or more nuts of the same color are placed next to each other, they disappear, freeing up space.

If none of the offered sets can be placed on the board, the level is lost.

title: Crazy Bar Brawl
description: Crazy Bar Brawl ?? throws you straight into the most chaotic, hilarious, and action-packed bar battles ever! If you’ve ever wondered what would happen if you walked into a bar full of drunk troublemakers ?, flying bottles ?, wobbling chairs ?, and wild characters who can barely stand… well, now you can experience it ALL—safely, virtually, and with maximum comedy!
instructions: Use Mouse/Touch to Aim click on the throw button to throw and smash

title: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style
description: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style brings romance, fashion, and K-pop glamour together in one stylish dress-up experience. Help your favorite K-pop hunters transform their looks for Valentine’s Day with stunning outfits, flawless makeup, and charming accessories.
instructions: Left mouse button click and Tap to play

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!
instructions:
Player 1:
W,A,S,D: Drive/Steer/Brake

Player 2:
Arrow Keys: Drive/Steer/Brake

title: Hot & Cold Winter Style
description: Princesses Eliza and Milana are going on winter vacation, but for each of the girls, winter vacation will be special. Eliza lives in snowy regions and loves fluffy fur coats, warm scarves and winter dresses. Milana celebrates her holidays under palm trees and chooses swimsuits, light capes and bright accessories. Players will have to create stylish images, combining the cold shine of snow and the warm glow of the tropics. Help Eliza and Milana become the most fashionable princesses of winter!
instructions: Go to the snowy North or the hot South to help the heroines of this game meet and spend their winter holidays in style. The fashionable images you created for this winter can be saved as a screenshot in PNG format. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

title: Sudoku Brain Blocks
description: Sudoku Brain Blocks is a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game that blends classic Sudoku logic with block-fitting challenges (Tetris style). Drag and drop various shaped blocks onto a 9×9 grid to complete full rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear the board and earn high scores. Use strategy and planning to avoid running out of space and test your brain with every move!
instructions: Drag and drop the given blocks onto the 9×9 grid. Complete full rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear them and score points. Plan your moves carefully—once there’s no space left for the blocks, the game is over.

title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
description: This is a first-person psychological horror game where you work night shifts in a small street kiosk. What seems like a normal job quickly turns into a nightmare: customers grow increasingly strange, and reality itself begins to warp. Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.
instructions:
You are a night shift worker at a shawarma kiosk. Customers come to you, and your job is to decide who to serve and who must be turned away.

Examine each visitor carefully: pay attention to their appearance, behavior, speech, and small oddities. If a customer seems suspicious, do not take their order and close the window.

title: Mojo Emoji
description: Moji Emoji is a fun and clever word/emoji puzzle game where each level challenges you to guess the hidden word or phrase from a set of expressive emojis. Think fast, connect the clues, and test your emoji decoding skills across hundreds of creative puzzles.
instructions: Click on the letter to place it the slot.

title: Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac
description:
Unwind and challenge your mind with Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac, a timeless puzzle game that blends strategy, focus, and relaxation. 
Match beautifully designed tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a calming gameplay experience anytime, anywhere.
Perfect for both beginners and seasoned players, Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac offers intuitive controls, elegant visuals, and satisfying puzzles that keep you coming back for more.
instructions:
1. Find two identical tiles that are open.
2. A tile is open if: no other tile on top of it and at least one side (left or right) free.
3. Tap two matching open tiles to remove them from the board.
4. Continue matching and removing tiles until the board i

title: Cookie monster
description: What more could you ask for?! Puzzle, brain teaser, monsters, snacks...wait what? That's right MONSTERS and SNACKS! Feed the hungry monsters snacks to pass the level! You have to make sure all the snacks get into the monster's mouth though or you will see a sad face! Let's keep these monsters happy! If you like the game, leave us a review! That will help us continue to bring you many more challenging levels, new monsters, maybe some new twizzler lines.
instructions: You need to draw lines in such a way as to get all the sweets straight into the monster's mouth.

title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description: Jixora is a relaxing jigsaw solitaire puzzle game where you piece together beautiful artwork. Journey through 100 unique levels with increasing difficulty, or unlock Free Play mode to replay your favorites with custom grid sizes. Race against the clock to earn stars, use strategic power-ups like Hints and Time Freezes, and immerse yourself in a cinematic atmosphere with soothing music.
instructions:
Controls:
Desktop: Click and drag to move puzzle pieces.
Mobile: Touch and drag to move pieces.
How to Play:
Drag pieces to arrange them. Adjacent pieces that belong together will snap and lock.
Complete the full image before the timer runs out.
Power-ups:
Hint (Lightbulb): Automatically moves a piece to its correct spot.
Peek (Eye): Shows the completed image for a few seconds.
Freeze (Snowflake): Pauses the timer for 10 seconds.

title: Fashion Stylist Salon Makeover
description: Do you want to create your own fashion styles? Join our best hair salon simulator game and enjoy the utmost fun. You will act as a fashion stylist who does haircuts, hairstyling, and skin care. Welcome customers with different requirements and use your hairstyling skills to make them satisfied and happy!
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Russian Derby Crash
description:
Russian Derby Crash is a thrilling game that immerses you in the atmosphere of spectacular car racing with elements of destruction. You'll control one of five Russian cars or a tank. Destroy cars on the training ground and unlock new ones!
This game has a unique twist: in addition to cars, there's a tank on the training ground, from which you can shoot at other participants!
instructions:
To unlock all the vehicles, you need to destroy them on the training ground!

Controls:
WASD - Drive.
C - Change camera.
Space - Handbrake.
Fire the tank - Left mouse button.
Zoom in on the tank - Right mouse button.

Mobile controls:
Use the on-screen game interface.

title: Tiny Farm
description:
Tiny Farm is a small, cozy farming game where everything grows at your pace.

Harvest crops, collect goods from animals, and slowly upgrade your farm into something wonderful. Each upgrade brings visible progress, and each world unlocks exciting new possibilities.

Sit back, relax, and watch your tiny farm flourish.

Cards with a number: the price is the number on the card.

Clear bubbles to stop the stack from reaching the bottom. Missed shots add fouls, and new rows appear when grey bubbles run out. Use the Swap booster to change your current bubble, the Fireball to blast through obstacles, and rely on Second Chances and Last Chances to keep playing and reach higher scores!

title: Kings and Queens Match 3
description: Step into Kings and Queens Match 3, the enchanting third chapter of the royal Match-3 adventure! Match jewels, crowns, and other royal artifacts to progress through exciting levels. Use powerful boosters like bombs, hammers, and royal blasts to clear challenging boards. Unlock new parts of the kingdom as you enjoy stunning visuals and a charming soundtrack. Join the royal quest and discover treasure, challenge, and endless fun!
instructions: Connect three or more items of the same type to remove them from the board. Every level has a goal that you have to achieve to proceed further. Focus on the goal and plan your moves carefully so that you don’t run out of them before completing the task! Use the Royal Bombs and Hammers to remove blockers and complete daily challenges for even more rewards.

title: Geometry Vibes X-Arrow
description: Geometry Vibes X Arrow is the newest evolution of the Geometry Vibes series, offering the most refined, competitive and customizable arrow experience so far. The goal is simple but demanding: guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths, survive increasingly difficult patterns and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything.
instructions:
Click MOUSE Left Click or press SPACE to accelerate upward.
Release the button to move downward.
In multiplayer, the additional players use H, L and the Up Arrow.
Touch controls are supported on phones and tablets.

title: My Garden Journey
description:
Grow your dream garden, raise animals, and enjoy peaceful farm life!

Welcome to My Garden Journey! ?? Start your peaceful farming adventure in My Garden Journey, the ultimate relaxing farming simulator!
instructions:
Grow Your Dream Garden – Plant a variety of seeds, water them, and watch your garden bloom into a colorful paradise. ?
Raise Adorable Animals – Take care of cute animals like chickens, cows, and more. Watch them thrive and help your farm grow! ?
Customize Your 3D Garden – Personalize every part of your garden with various decorations, plants, and layouts to make it uniquely yours. ?

title: Merge Tower Hero
description: Dive into Merge Tower Hero, an exhilarating online puzzle - Merge game that sharpens your mathematical thinking while exhilaratingly combining action, strategy, and combat. Assemble your team and tackle challenging battles that require not only strength but clever gameplay strategies to prevail!
instructions: Use the mouse or touch to merge the characters

title: Merge Christmas
description: Merge Christmas is a festive puzzle game where you combine matching snowballs to create new character / bigger snowballs, and unlock a cozy Christmas world. Relax and merge Christmas-themed snowballs in a cheerful winter atmosphere perfect for the holiday season.
instructions:
Desktop: Move mouse to move the snowball, then release to drop it.
Mobile: Tap and drag to move the snowball, then release to drop it.
Drop snowballs into the box to merge two or more identical ones to create new character / bigger snowballs.

title: Rescue Sharp Turn
description: Rescue Puzzle 3D is a lightweight 3D fun puzzle game. You need to click on the correct objects in the small three-dimensional scene to trigger mechanisms, remove obstacles or form a chain reaction to meet the level conditions and rescue the injured character. The levels are short but full of ingenuity: turn off the power switch, move rocks, release water to extinguish fire, synthesize props...
instructions:
PC:Left Click to interact
Mobile:Tap interaction
Retry button to reopen this switch with one click

title: Steal Brainrot Monsters!
description:
Step into a world of fun, charm, and Italian flair with Buy Cute and Funny Animals! From the tiny and delightful Nubini Pizzanini to the rare and majestic Tralalelo Tralala and the playful Los Tralalelitos, there’s no shortage of adorable creatures to collect.

Build your very own cozy base, place your animals in it, and make them feel right at home. In return, they’ll reward you with coins, which you can use to unlock even more animals and exciting upgrades.
instructions:
For computers:

- Move using the arrow keys

- Rotate the camera using mouse movements

- Interact with animals using the U key

- Jump using the space bar

For phones:

- Move using the joystick on the left side of the screen

- Rotate the camera using the right side of the screen

- Interact with monsters using the pop-up window above the monster

- Jump using the button on the right side of the screen

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

title: Ball Craze Sort
description:
Ball Craze Sort is a fun, relaxing, and addictive puzzle game where your goal is to sort colorful balls into the correct order. What starts as a simple task quickly turns into a brain-teasing challenge as more colors and tubes are introduced.
Ball Craze Sort is the perfect game to unwind or mentally recharge. Whether you’re looking to relax for a few minutes or challenge your logic skills for hours, this game offers the ideal balance between fun and focus.
instructions:
Tap on a tube to pick up the top ball

Tap another tube to drop the ball

You can only place a ball onto another of the same color or an empty tube

Sort all balls so that each tube contains only one color

Use strategy and planning to avoid getting stuck as levels get harder!

Tip: If you run out of moves, you can restart the level or use a hint to help find the next step.

title: Sand Blast
description:
Sand Blast – A Satisfying Flowing-Sand Puzzle Experience, a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game built on soft, flowing sand physics!
Every block is made of loose, unstable sand — place it, and it instantly crumbles and shifts with gravity. These pieces won’t stay still, so you’ll need to think ahead and plan every move carefully.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Nine Cards Of Winter
description:
Get into the holiday spirit with Nine Cards of Winter, a fun and relaxing tile-matching game!
Pick up to 9 Christmas tiles and match 3 of the same to clear them. Watch out — if your stack fills up, the game is over!
Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles, solve tricky puzzles, and enjoy cute holiday designs.It’s easy to play, relaxing to enjoy, and full of winter charm!
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to tap tiles and match three of the same to clear them.

title: Darts Jam
description:
This is a casual game of shooting balloons with darts.

When all the darts are pulled out, the board will also fall. When all the boards fall, the game is won.

The game is easy and simple to play, and the difficulty is getting stronger and stronger, which is challenging
instructions:
Click on the dart, and the balloon of the same color as the dart will be shot.

If there is no balloon of the same color, the dart will be temporarily placed.

Only the dart that can be seen completely can be clicked.

As the game progresses, the colors of the darts and balloons will increase, and the difficulty will also increase.

title: CUBE KING
description:
Show them who's the real King here!

New cubes appear from the portals at the bottom. Your task is to connect cubes with the same numbers by moving them from one stack to another!

You get coins for every merge. Use them wisely:
Upgrade a selected cube!
Unlock new portals with cubes!
Increase the starting level of cubes!
Extinguish burning cubes or instantly shatter the ice on all frozen cubes!

But be careful: if a stack overflows, the game ends!
instructions:
Every 15 seconds, cubes appear on the rods.
Move them between rods to connect cubes with the same number!

If a stack overflows, the game ends.

1 Tap a cube to select it.
2 Tap another cube where you want to place it.
3 You get coins for merging cubes.

When a cube with a number divisible by 5 (5, 10, 15, 20, 25) appears, you get a random boost.
Boosts can be good or bad :)
Good ones:
Extra coins!
Upgrade random cubes!
Bad ones:
Fire Arrows - burning cubes lose 1 index every 5 seconds!

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!
instructions: Use left mouse button to play the game.

title: Roller Coaster 3D
description:
Go through this roller coaster, pick up more passengers along the way and have more fun!
Can you pass all the obstacles and enjoy all the crazy loops?
Enjoy the ride!
Unlocks all the different mechanics and many levels!
instructions:
The gameplay is simple:

just swipe left or right
try to collect as much money as possible
and also try to attract more people to you and avoid obstacles

title: Blast Cubes
description: Blast Cubes is an addictive puzzle game where players strategically place cubes on a grid. When cubes align in horizontal or vertical rows, they explode, triggering an exciting chain reaction! After the explosion, characters of the same color as the exploded cube emerge and move towards vehicles of the same color waiting at the top. Once the vehicles are filled, new ones appear, continuing the cycle.
instructions:
1. Place Cubes on the Grid

2. Create Matches to Blast Cubes

3. Watch Characters Rush Out

4. Fill the Vehicles

5. Complete the Level Goal

6. Think Ahead

title: Stickman Weapon Master
description:
Fight as a lone brave stickman against the tyranny and Evil
Fight as a lone brave stickman against the tyranny and evil Lord in the land of Stickman Weapon Master.
instructions: Experience the deep and satisfying combat system, packed with numerous weapons and different play style for you to master. Feel the thrill after every swing and the glory after every kill.

title: Furry Wedding Proposal
description: Hi, young stylist! You will find a very unusual couple in love - a brutal fox and a feminine bunny - who are preparing for their future wedding. They dream of looking stunning on this holiday and you will become their main assistant in this exciting adventure! You have to dress the characters in beautiful wedding dresses, choose stylish hairstyles for them and apply light makeup. Create, fantasize and create a fairy tale!
instructions: This game takes you to a fictional world of anthropomorphic animals, where you will create vivid wedding images for a very unusual couple of lovers. The most interesting wedding images can be saved as a screenshot in PNG format. Depending on the gaming device, either a click of a computer mouse or a simple touch on touchscreens is used to control it.

title: Bloon Pop
description:
Bloon Pop is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you rotate the frame to pop colorful balloons using a spinning saw!
Use gravity and timing to guide all the balloons toward the blades and watch them burst into vibrant splashes of color.
With bright visuals and relaxing gameplay, Bloon Pop offers satisfying fun for players of all ages. Can you pop them all?
instructions:
Rotate the frame by dragging or tapping to change its angle.
Use gravity to move the saw toward the balloons.
When the balloons touch the blade, they pop in a burst of color.
Pop all the balloons to complete the level and unlock the next one.

title: Marble Blast
description: Ready to match, blast, and conquer? This vibrant marble shooter game offers endless fun and challenges that test your skills and strategy. Clear colorful marbles, unlock powerful boosters, and prove you’re the master of marble puzzles! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers excitement like no other.
instructions:
Tap to aim and shoot marbles from the launcher.
Match 3+ marbles of the same color to clear them.
Stop the marble chain before it reaches the end of the path.
Use bombs, lasers, and other special tools to beat tough levels.
Replay levels or undo moves to perfect your strategy.
Whether you’re chasing high scores, collecting rewards, or just relaxing after a busy day, this marble shooter offers hours of pure fun. The question is—are you ready to become the ultimate marble master?

title: Road Of Fury 4

Use mouse/finger to aim the guns.

1, 2, 3 to activate super-powers.

Stick vs Monster School 2 is now fighting zombies!

He's in for fights and epic battles in the world during the zombie apocalypse!

- Fight zombies and bosses!

Did you like the game "Stick vs Monster School 2"? - Then write a review and play all our games about stickmen.

Arrows - move.
Space \ E - attack.
Defeat all enemies on the level to move to the next one.
Collect coins and upgrade your stickman!

title: Word Clash
description: Words are the key to progress. With a massive number of levels to explore, you will improve your vocabulary. Use hints when needed and stay hooked for hours. Keep solving, keep learning and see how many challenges you can conquer along the way.
instructions: Letters are randomly placed on the board. The goal is to form words. The number of empty spaces above indicates how many words need to be created. Hints can be used for tough spots, while relaxing backgrounds change as you progress.

title: Nuwpy's Adventure
description:
Nuwpy’s Adventure is a classic pixel-art platformer inspired by retro arcade games!
Help Nuwpy explore colorful worlds, collect coins, jump over enemies, and avoid traps.
Each level offers new challenges, hidden secrets, and a fast-paced journey full of charm and nostalgia.
Dive into the pixel world and enjoy simple yet addictive gameplay!

Use the arrow keys to move left or right.
Press Space to jump.
Collect coins, avoid enemies, and reach the end of the level to win.
Be careful — just a few mistakes, and you’ll have to start again!

title: Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. Place the Christmas-themed hexagon tiles stacks onto the board and sort the same color tiles to collect them. The game combines a light puzzle that requires attention and logic — perfect for relaxing while stimulating your brain. 2 game modes, infinite levels, a user-friendly interface, and save support let you play anytime without losing progress.

Tap to select a stack of hexagonal tiles.
Drag to move it onto the board. Release to place it.
Same color tiles will be auto-sorted (stacked).
Tiles are collected once at least 10 tiles having the same color are sorted.

title: Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary
description: Welcome to Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary – the place where your style dreams come to life! Step into the shoes of a talented fashion designer, build your own boutique, and create stunning outfits that dazzle the world. From fabric to final look, you’re in charge of every stitch!
instructions: Cut, sew, and style beautiful clothes for your fashion-loving clients. Whether it's a red carpet gown, a chic office outfit, or a cute casual set, you can make it all! Mix and match trendy fabrics, add sparkly accessories, and create personalized looks that fit every occasion.

title: Pet Me Maze
description:
Welcome to Pet Me Maze, the most hilarious and addictive maze puzzle game that combines humor, challenge, and adorable pets
Are you ready to test your wits and reflexes in a maze full of surprises, traps, and funny moments

It sounds easy but each level introduces new twists that keep the challenge fresh and fun every time you play

title: Epic Stunts PvP 3D
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!
instructions:
Player 1:
W,A,S,D: Drive/Steer/Brake

Player 2:
Arrow Keys: Drive/Steer/Brake

title: Hexa Tap Away
description: Hexa Tap Away is a sleek one-direction hex puzzle. Drag tiles to move them in the only direction they can travel, create space, and clear the board. Each level adds trickier layouts, blockers, and tight corridors that demand planning ahead. Short, snackable stages, smooth controls, and a clean look make it easy to start and hard to stop. Stuck? Try a hint or rethink your route and there’s always a smarter move!

On Desktop: MOUSE and LEFT-CLICK
On Mobile: Touch Controls

title: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure, where quick thinking and strategy collide in an exciting online card challenge. Build your deck, make smart moves, and face thrilling encounters that test your skills and timing. Designed for both desktop and mobile players, this free-to-play adventure delivers fast, tactical gameplay and endless replayability. Every decision shapes your path — can you conquer the quest in just ten minutes?
instructions:
• Deck Building: Before starting a match, create your deck using cards you’ve collected. Customize your deck based on strategy—focus on attack-heavy units, healing abilities, or powerful spells. 
• Winning Conditions: Outlast your opponent by maintaining stronger forces, controlling key areas, and dealing consistent damage.

title: Matching Puzzle
description:
Paintings blocks fall from the sky.
When you touch the ground, the pictures are covered, remember that picture and guess the same picture.
If you match the picture quickly, you can get additional points as a combo.

title: Radical Rappelling
description:
Feel the rush and hold on tight as Radical Rappelling is back!

Join Rip and Roxy as you rappel down mountains at breakneck speed using your rapid reflexes.

Pull off death-defying tricks by ricocheting between launch pads, riding rainbows and rocketing over obstacles in the most redonkulous adventure ever.

Rack up coins and complete rockin’ missions to unlock sweet new gear for Rip and Roxy, the most fearless risk-takers on the planet.

title: Cinema Business - Idle Games
description:
Build and manage your own cinema empire! 
Unlock movie rooms, snack and burger corners to attract more customers.
Hire staff, upgrade facilities, and keep your theater running smoothly.
Earn cash even while you’re offline and grow your business.
Become the ultimate cinema tycoon in this fun idle arcade game!

Unlock movie rooms, snack corners, and expand your theater to attract more customers.
Hire staff, serve popcorn, and become the ultimate cinema tycoon in this fun idle arcade game!

title: Chain Puzzle
description: Chain Puzzle is a relaxing logic game where you carefully untangle intricate chained constructions. Each construction is a single system of two same-colored balls connected by a chain. Every move changes the shape of the structure: the chain can automatically shorten, opening new ways to solve the puzzle. Observe, adjust positions, and find the right sequence of actions to completely unravel the knot.
instructions: In front of you are balls connected by chains and bolts around which the chain can get tangled. Drag the balls to change the position of the entire construction and gradually free it from twists. Make sure the chain doesn’t wrap around bolts — your goal is to fully untangle the structure and keep the chain straight and free. Think ahead and choose the right movement paths to solve the puzzle.

title: Sort Game Toy Sort

Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Royal Garden Match 2
description: Royal Garden Match 2 is here! Join Aria as she tends the kingdom’s most prestigious Royal Garden. Restore it to its former glory by completing fun match-3 puzzles! Match royal flowers, fruits, and plants across hundreds of levels packed with daily missions and challenges. Enjoy a magical journey full of beauty, strategy, and rewards. Play Royal Garden Match 2 now and bring the Royal Garden back to life!
instructions: Match three or more identical icons in this exciting tile-matching game! Swap flowers, fruits, and plants by dragging them to switch places—each move must form a valid match. Keep an eye on the panel to see which items to collect and how many moves you have. Match 4 or 5 pieces to unleash powerful line bursts, cross bursts, and color boosters. Merge boosters for even bigger effects! Strategize your moves, create stunning combos, and complete levels with dazzling garden magic!

title: Mojicon Winter Connect
description:
The Mojicon series returns for the holidays! Match festive tiles, break the new Ice Sheet blockers, and enjoy a relaxing winter puzzle adventure. ❄️
Mojicon Winter Connect takes the classic Onet matching fun you love and covers it in a layer of fresh snow. Immerse yourself in a cozy holiday atmosphere, connecting festive icons like reindeer, gingerbread men, and happy snowmen.
Fast, satisfying, and full of seasonal charm – it’s the perfect winter puzzle for all ages. ✨✨✨

Tap or click two matching emoji tiles to connect them with a line and clear them from the board.
The connection path can turn up to two times – plan your matches carefully!
Clear the board before time runs out to win stars.
Use Hints or Shuffle power-ups when you’re stuck, and chase the highest combo streak!

title: Word Connect Puzzle

Earn stars, complete daily challenges, and use hints when you’re stuck. Play offline anytime, enjoy clean visuals and smooth controls, and chase streak bonuses for higher scores. Perfect for quick sessions or long puzzle runs—smart, simple, and satisfying for all ages.
instructions:
On Desktop:
MOUSE and LEFT-CLICK

On Mobile Devices:
Touch Controls

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

Avoid and pop the bubbles.
SPACE to shoot, ARROW KEYS to move.

You can earn money by collecting socks and you can also earn money by defeating your friend. You must be very careful; steal the Lucky Block from your friend and keep it until the time is up.

*Use the WASD and Arrow keys to move.

*Playable on both mobile and PC.

title: Ping Pong Air

Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

Control the bat with your mouse or finger, bouncing the ball like in real table tennis.
In the classic mode, defeat opponents and earn trophies.
In the Halloween mode, banish spirits in a limited time.
In the career, go from beginner to champion, and in the challenge, hit the targets without missing. Earn crystal orbs, unlock new bats and get achievements.

Mobile:

Touch Down Arrow  = Move to down

Gift Merge: Santa World Tour

Help Santa spread Christmas joy across the globe!
Tap to generate gifts, merge identical items to craft new toys, and fulfill children’s wishes to raise each country’s happiness. Travel from snowy towns to sunny beaches, unlocking new festive destinations. Merge, match, and make magic — the more joy you spread, the closer Santa gets to completing his world tour!

Obstacles such as various sources, restricted routes, or challenging layouts are specific to each level.

Car Parking. A puzzle game with cars and passengers.
Complete interesting levels with various mechanics!
The game will be interesting for both who want to relax leisurely and for those who like to unravel complex moves.
Easy levels are combined with more difficult ones. And some will be a real challenge for your brain!

Left mouse button - click on the selected car. When you tap, the car rides to the parking place. If the car's color matches the color of the first passengers, they board the car. When all passengers board, the car rides away.
To make your task easier, you can use boosters:

- Sorting the queue,
- VIP parking.

THE KULKA is a one-button bullet-heaven arcade game where your single shot evolves into chaos. Inspired by Flappy Birds, Vampire Survivor and Pattern Survivors: Bullet Hell. 

MUTATE YOUR BULLET. FLAP, EVOLVE, SURVIVE.

4. Survive as long as possible!

You can freely move left and right across the location and use zoom to find hidden objects.
